examples_extra: 'Tall' is an adjective that describes a person.
In 'red car', the adjective comes before the noun.
note_fa: «کلمه‌ای که اسم را توصیف می‌کند؛ قبل از اسم: a tall man.»

meaning_en: A small change made to improve something.
example_en: We made a small adjustment to the plan.
examples_extra: He made a small adjustment to the seat height.
The plan needs some adjustment before we start.
note_fa: «تغییر کوچک برای بهتر شدن؛ فعلش adjust است.»

meaning_en: Short for administration; managing an organization.
example_en: She works in admin at the office.
examples_extra: She does the admin for a small company.
The admin takes up most of his morning.

meaning_en: A person who manages an organization or system.
example_en: The system administrator fixed the problem.
examples_extra: The network administrator fixed the server.
She works as an administrator in a busy office.
note_fa: «مدیر اجرایی امور؛ در واحد jobs کتاب.»

meaning_en: To respect and approve of someone or something.
example_en: I admire her courage and hard work.
examples_extra: I admire her courage in speaking out.
We admired the view from the mountain top.
note_fa: «یعنی «تحسین کردن»؛ قوی‌تر از like: admire her courage.»

meaning_en: The right to enter a place or join a group.
example_en: Admission to the museum is free.
examples_extra: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
He paid the admission and went inside.
note_fa: «حق ورود؛ admission free یعنی ورود رایگان.»

meaning_en: To agree that something is true, often unwillingly.
example_en: I admit I was wrong about that.
examples_extra: He admitted that he had broken the window.
She refused to admit her mistake.

meaning_en: Used to say that you accept something is true.
example_en: Admittedly, the task was difficult.
examples_extra: Admittedly, the task was harder than we expected.
The film was long; admittedly, it was beautiful.
note_fa: «یعنی «هرچند باید پذیرفت»؛ اول جمله با ویرگول.»

meaning_en: To love someone or something very much.
example_en: She adores her grandchildren.
examples_extra: She simply adores her little brother.
They adore spending weekends by the sea.
note_fa: «قوی‌تر از love؛ در جدول دوست‌داشتن کتاب: love, adore, idolise.»

meaning_en: A person who is fully grown.
example_en: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
examples_extra: Tickets are cheaper for children than for adults.
You must be an adult to vote in the election.

meaning_en: A place where adults can take classes.
example_en: I'm taking a class at the adult education centre.
examples_extra: She takes Spanish classes at the adult education centre.
The adult education centre offers courses in cooking and computing.
note_fa: مرکز آموزش بزرگسالان؛ دوره‌های شبانه و آخر هفته برای بزرگسالان.

meaning_en: The state or period of being an adult.
example_en: He reached adulthood at eighteen.
examples_extra: Adulthood brings new freedoms but also new responsibilities.
He moved out of his parents' house in early adulthood.

meaning_en: To make progress or move forward.
example_en: Medical science continues to advance rapidly.
examples_extra: Our troops continued to advance towards the city.
She advanced quickly to a senior position in her new job.
note_fa: هم «پیشرفت کردن» هم «جلو رفتن» معنا می‌دهد.

meaning_en: Something that helps you be better or more successful.
example_en: Living near the park is an advantage.
examples_extra: His experience gave him a clear advantage over the others.
There are many advantages to living near your workplace.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: have an advantage؛ take advantage of.

meaning_en: A holiday involving exciting and dangerous activities.
example_en: We went on an adventure holiday last year.
examples_extra: They went on an adventure holiday in the mountains.
An adventure holiday can include climbing, rafting, or jungle walks.
note_fa: تعطیلات هیجانی و کمی خطرناک؛ با go on می‌آید.

meaning_en: Willing to take risks and try new things.
example_en: She is an adventurous traveler.
examples_extra: He's adventurous and loves trying strange foods.
They are an adventurous couple who travel everywhere.
note_fa: معنای مثبت دارد: اهل ماجراجویی و تجربه‌های تازه.

meaning_en: A word that describes a verb, adjective, or another adverb.
example_en: "Quickly" is an adverb.
examples_extra: In 'she sings beautifully', beautifully is an adverb.
An adverb can describe a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
note_fa: بسیاری از قیدها با ly- ساخته می‌شوند: quick ← quickly.

meaning_en: A short film or message promoting a product.
example_en: I saw an advert for a new car.
examples_extra: I saw an advert for a new phone on TV.
She answered an advert for a part-time job.
note_fa: شکل کوتاه و غیررسمی advertisement؛ در بریتانیا رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: To tell people about a product or service.
example_en: They need to advertise their new product.
examples_extra: They advertise their products on social media.
The college advertises evening courses in the local paper.

meaning_en: A public notice promoting a product, service, or event.
example_en: I saw an advertisement for a job.
examples_extra: The advertisement showed a happy family on the beach.
He put an advertisement in the paper to sell his car.

meaning_en: A person or company that advertises products.
example_en: The advertiser paid a lot for that slot.
examples_extra: The main advertiser pulled out of the TV show.
Advertisers spend millions on online campaigns every year.
note_fa: شخص یا شرکتی که تبلیغ می‌کند.

meaning_en: Suggestions about what someone should do.
example_en: Can you give me some advice?
examples_extra: She gave me some useful advice about the interview.
If you need advice, ask someone you trust.
note_fa: غیرقابل شمارش است: some advice، نه an advice.

meaning_en: To give suggestions about what someone should do.
example_en: I advise you to study hard.
examples_extra: The doctor advised him to rest for a week.
I advise you to check the timetable before leaving.
note_fa: تلفظ با /z/ است؛ بعد از آن to می‌آید: advise sb to do.

meaning_en: A vehicle with wings that flies through the air.
example_en: We traveled by aeroplane to Paris.
examples_extra: The aeroplane took off half an hour late.
We watched the aeroplane disappear into the clouds.

meaning_en: To have enough money to buy or do something.
meaning_fa: از عهده برآمدن، توانایی مالی داشتن
example_en: I can't afford a new car.
examples_extra: We can't afford to go on holiday this year.
Can you afford a new car right now?
note_fa: ساختار: afford + اسم یا afford to + فعل.

meaning_en: Feeling fear; scared of something.
example_en: She is afraid of spiders.
examples_extra: The little boy is afraid of the dark.
Are you afraid to swim in deep water?
note_fa: بعد از آن of یا to می‌آید: afraid of dogs / afraid to ask.

meaning_en: Feeling fear about something.
example_en: Are you afraid of the dark?
examples_extra: She is afraid of spiders and mice.
He's afraid of flying, so he takes the train.
note_fa: همیشه با of می‌آید و بعد از آن اسم یا ing.

meaning_en: A large continent south of Europe.
example_en: Africa is a big continent.
examples_extra: Africa is the second-largest continent in the world.
They went on safari in East Africa last summer.
note_fa: حرف اول همیشه بزرگ: Africa نه africa.

meaning_en: Relating to Africa or its people.
example_en: She loves African music.
examples_extra: She loves African music, dance, and food.
An African elephant is larger than an Asian one.
note_fa: هم صفت است هم اسم: an African یعنی یک آفریقایی.

meaning_en: Relating to people of African descent living in the Caribbean.
example_en: He has African-Caribbean heritage.
examples_extra: Many African-Caribbean families live in this part of London.
The festival celebrates African-Caribbean culture and food.
note_fa: گروه قومی؛ با خط تیره و حرف بزرگ نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: later than something else
example_en: We will go to the park after lunch.
examples_extra: She arrived after the meeting had already started.
We went for a long walk after lunch.
note_fa: متضاد before؛ بعد از آن اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: following someone or something
example_en: The dog ran after the ball.
examples_extra: The dog ran after the ball into the street.
She looked after her younger brother all evening.

meaning_en: when something has happened
example_en: I will call you after I finish work.
examples_extra: After the film ended, we walked home together.
She called me after she arrived at the hotel.
note_fa: حرف ربط است؛ بعد از آن جمله کامل می‌آید.

meaning_en: next, following a previous event
example_en: We ate dinner, and after that, we watched a movie.
examples_extra: We had dinner; after that, we watched a film.
He finished school and after that found a job.
note_fa: یعنی «بعد از آن»؛ برای ترتیب اتفاق‌ها به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: the part of the day after noon
example_en: I like to read books in the afternoon.
examples_extra: Good afternoon! How can I help you?
She usually goes jogging in the afternoon.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: in the afternoon؛ this afternoon.

meaning_en: at a later time
example_en: We went to the cinema and ate afterwards.
examples_extra: We had lunch and afterwards went shopping.
He felt sick afterwards, so he went home.
note_fa: قید است و معمولاً ابتدای جمله یا بعد از فعل می‌آید.

meaning_en: disagreeing with something or someone
example_en: Many people are against the new law.
examples_extra: Most people voted against the new law.
She is against testing products on animals.

meaning_en: competing with someone
example_en: Our team played against a strong opponent.
examples_extra: Our team is playing against the champions tomorrow.
The dollar rose against the euro this week.
note_fa: در مسابقه و ورزش: تیم الف در برابر تیم ب.

meaning_en: touching something or someone
example_en: He leaned his bike against the wall.
examples_extra: She leaned her bike against the wall.
He rested his head against the window and slept.

meaning_en: how old a person or thing is
example_en: What is your age? I am ten.
examples_extra: What age will your daughter be in June?
At the age of five, he could already read.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: he is 30 نه he has 30.

meaning_en: becoming older
example_en: Ageing skin needs special care.
examples_extra: The country has a rapidly ageing population.
The natural ageing process affects everyone differently.
note_fa: یعنی «در حال پیر شدن»؛ the ageing process.

meaning_en: a very long time
example_en: I haven't seen you for ages!
examples_extra: We waited for ages, but the bus never came.
I haven't seen you for ages! How are you?
note_fa: در عبارت for ages یعنی «مدت خیلی طولانی».

meaning_en: a very long time in the past
example_en: I visited that city ages ago.
examples_extra: They first met ages ago, back in school.
That old cinema closed down ages ago.
note_fa: غیررسمی و تأکیدی‌تر از long ago.

meaning_en: behaving in an angry or violent way
example_en: His aggressive behavior scared everyone.
examples_extra: The dog became aggressive and started barking loudly.
He took an aggressive approach in the business talks.
note_fa: بار منفی دارد؛ با assertive (قاطع) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: a state of worry or anxiety
example_en: She felt great agitation before her exam.
examples_extra: There was a state of agitation in the crowd.
She waited in a state of nervous agitation.
note_fa: با a state of می‌آید: in a state of agitation.

meaning_en: in the past, from now
example_en: I saw him two days ago.
examples_extra: I moved to this city two years ago.
He left ten minutes ago, so hurry up.
note_fa: بعد از عبارت زمانی می‌آید: two days ago.

meaning_en: to have the same opinion
example_en: Yes, I agree with you.
examples_extra: I completely agree with everything you just said.
They finally agreed to meet at six o'clock.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: I agree نه I am agree.

meaning_en: to share the same idea or belief
example_en: We both agree on the plan.
examples_extra: I agree with you on this point.
Experts agree that exercise is good for health.
note_fa: ساختار: agree with + شخص یا نظر.

meaning_en: to say yes to a suggestion
example_en: She agreed to help me with my homework.
examples_extra: She agreed to help us with the move.
They agreed a price and shook hands.
note_fa: ساختارها: agree to + فعل؛ agree on/about + موضوع.

meaning_en: a formal decision or arrangement
example_en: They reached an agreement after long talks.
examples_extra: The two companies signed an agreement yesterday.
We finally reached an agreement after long talks.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: reach/sign an agreement؛ in agreement with.

meaning_en: help or support
example_en: The country sent aid to disaster victims.
examples_extra: The charity sent aid to the flood victims.
Several countries offered aid after the earthquake.

meaning_en: a serious disease that attacks the body's immune system
example_en: Research continues to find a cure for AIDS.
examples_extra: He contracted AIDS in the 1990s and died young.
Doctors are working to find a cure for AIDS.
note_fa: مخفف acquired immune deficiency syndrome؛ با contract می‌آید.

meaning_en: a goal or purpose
example_en: My aim is to learn English well.
examples_extra: Our main aim is to finish by Friday.
She achieved her aim of becoming a doctor.
note_fa: عبارت: with the aim of + ing.

meaning_en: the gas around us that we breathe
example_en: We need clean air to live.
examples_extra: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
The mountain air is clean and cool.
note_fa: غیرقابل شمارش؛ عبارت: in the open air.

meaning_en: short for air conditioning
example_en: It's hot, let's turn on the air con.
examples_extra: The car has air con, so the trip was comfortable.
Turn on the air con; it's too hot in here.
note_fa: شکل کوتاه و غیررسمی air conditioning.

meaning_en: a system that cools the air
example_en: The car has good air conditioning.
examples_extra: Our old flat doesn't have air conditioning.
The office has air conditioning throughout the building.

meaning_en: the part of the army that uses planes
example_en: My uncle works in the air force.
examples_extra: He joined the air force after leaving school.
The air force uses fast fighter planes.
note_fa: نیروی هوایی؛ خلبان‌ها در آن خدمت می‌کنند.

meaning_en: harmful substances in the air
example_en: Air pollution is a big problem in cities.
examples_extra: Cars and factories cause most air pollution.
Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.

meaning_en: managing aircraft movement safely
example_en: Air traffic control guides planes safely.
examples_extra: Air traffic control told the pilot to wait ten minutes.
He works in air traffic control at Heathrow.
note_fa: مرکز کنترل پروازها و هدایت هواپیماها.

meaning_en: having a system that cools the air
example_en: The hotel room was air-conditioned.
examples_extra: All the hotel rooms are air-conditioned.
We escaped the heat in an air-conditioned café.

meaning_en: a vehicle that flies, like a plane
example_en: Many aircraft fly over our house.
examples_extra: The aircraft took off twenty minutes late.
Two military aircraft flew over the town.
note_fa: جمع و مفرد یکسان است: one aircraft, two aircraft.

meaning_en: a company that owns and operates planes
example_en: Which airline are you flying with?
examples_extra: Which airline are you flying with to Tehran?
The airline lost my suitcase for two days.

meaning_en: a place where planes take off and land
example_en: We arrived at the airport early.
examples_extra: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
The new airport is thirty kilometres from town.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: the journey to the airport نه the travel.

meaning_en: feeling sick because of flying
example_en: She felt airsick during the long flight.
examples_extra: I got airsick during the bumpy flight.
She felt airsick as the plane took off.

meaning_en: the feeling of being sick from flying
example_en: He took medicine for airsickness.
examples_extra: He suffers from airsickness on long flights.
Airsickness is caused by the plane's movement.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از get airsick؛ با suffer from می‌آید.

meaning_en: also known as
example_en: John Smith, AKA "The Boss," arrived.
examples_extra: The singer, AKA 'Luna', released a new song.
James Smith, AKA Jim, is my neighbour.
note_fa: مخفف also known as؛ غیررسمی و نوشتاری.

meaning_en: a sudden feeling of fear
example_en: The loud noise caused alarm.
examples_extra: The fire alarm went off at midnight.
He set the alarm for six o'clock.
note_fa: عبارت: the alarm goes off یعنی زنگ می‌زند.

meaning_en: a clock that makes a sound to wake you
example_en: My alarm clock rings at 7 AM.
examples_extra: My alarm clock rings at six every morning.
She bought a new alarm clock yesterday.

meaning_en: a collection of songs by one artist
example_en: I bought her new music album.
examples_extra: Their new album has twelve songs on it.
She bought the album the day it came out.
note_fa: عبارت‌ها: record/release an album؛ the album comes out.

meaning_en: drinks like beer or wine
example_en: Do you drink alcohol?
examples_extra: He never drinks any alcohol at parties.
This shop is not allowed to sell alcohol.
note_fa: غیرقابل شمارش؛ non-alcoholic یعنی بدون الکل.

meaning_en: Burning brightly; on fire.
example_en: The old house was completely alight after the fire started.
examples_extra: Passengers must not alight while the bus is moving.
We alighted from the train at the last stop.
note_fa: رسمی و قدیمی؛ معادل get off از اتوبوس/قطار.

meaning_en: Not dead; living.
example_en: Is your cat still alive?
examples_extra: The fish is still alive in the bucket.
He was lucky to be alive after the accident.
note_fa: متضاد dead؛ بعد از فعل می‌آید نه قبل از اسم.

meaning_en: Doing something completely or not at all.
example_en: His approach to work is all or nothing; he gives 100% or quits.
examples_extra: For him, it's all or nothing — no half measures.
She took an all-or-nothing approach to the exam.
note_fa: یعنی «یا همه یا هیچ»؛ بدون حد وسط.

meaning_en: In every part of a place.
example_en: There were toys all over the floor.
examples_extra: There were toys all over the living-room floor.
They travelled all over Japan last spring.
note_fa: یعنی «در همه جای»؛ بعد از آن مکان می‌آید.

meaning_en: A friendly way to say goodbye or wish good luck.
example_en: All the best with your new job!
examples_extra: All the best for your driving test tomorrow!
All the best, and please keep in touch!

meaning_en: Using maximum effort or resources.
example_en: The team made an all-out effort to win the championship.
examples_extra: The workers went on an all-out strike.
The team made an all-out effort to win.
note_fa: یعنی «تمام‌عیار»؛ با خط تیره نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: To give something for a specific purpose.
example_en: We need to allocate funds for the new project.
examples_extra: The school allocated funds for new computers.
Each group was allocated a different task.
note_fa: یعنی تخصیص دادن برای هدف مشخص.

meaning_en: To let someone do something.
example_en: My parents allow me to play outside.
examples_extra: They allow dogs inside this small café.
Smoking is not allowed in the building.
note_fa: غالباً به‌صورت مجهول: be allowed to؛ let غیررسمی‌تر است.

meaning_en: Money given regularly, often to children.
example_en: My parents give me a weekly allowance for chores.
examples_extra: She gets a weekly allowance from her parents.
His monthly allowance covers food and transport.
note_fa: پول توجیبی منظم، معمولاً برای بچه‌ها.

meaning_en: Very nearly; not quite.
example_en: I almost missed the bus this morning.
examples_extra: I'm almost ready — give me two minutes.
Almost everyone in the class passed the test.
note_fa: قبل از all و every می‌آید: almost all.

meaning_en: Without other people.
example_en: She likes to read alone in her room.
examples_extra: She lives alone in a small flat.
He was alone in the house all night.

meaning_en: In addition to; together with.
example_en: He sent the report along with a cover letter.
examples_extra: He brought his sister along with him.
Along with the rain came strong, cold winds.

meaning_en: Next to; beside.
example_en: The boat docked alongside the pier.
examples_extra: She parked her car alongside the kerb.
Alongside her teaching job, she writes children's books.

meaning_en: Speaking so others can hear.
example_en: Please read the story aloud.
examples_extra: She read the story aloud to the children.
Please don't read aloud during the test.

meaning_en: All the letters used in a language.
example_en: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
examples_extra: Children learn the alphabet before they start reading.
The words are listed in alphabetical order.

meaning_en: In addition; too.
example_en: I like pizza, and I also like pasta.
examples_extra: She speaks French and also a little Italian.
It's raining and also very windy today.

meaning_en: To change something, usually slightly.

examples_extra: They altered the design slightly after the meeting.
Nothing can alter what happened that day.

meaning_en: A change, usually small.
example_en: The tailor made an alteration to my dress.
examples_extra: The tailor made a few alterations to the suit.
They made some alterations to the original plan.
note_fa: با پسوند tion- از فعل alter ساخته شده.

meaning_en: Another choice or option.
example_en: Is there an alternative route to avoid traffic?
examples_extra: Is there an alternative to taking the car?
We had no alternative but to wait.
note_fa: عبارت: have no alternative but to.

meaning_en: Despite the fact that.
example_en: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
examples_extra: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
He's very friendly, although he's quite shy.
note_fa: حرف ربط؛ even though تأکیدی‌تر است.

meaning_en: Completely; in total.
example_en: There were five people altogether at the party.
examples_extra: There were twelve of us altogether at dinner.
That comes to twenty pounds altogether, please.

meaning_en: At all times; every time.

examples_extra: She always arrives at least ten minutes early.
I always drink black coffee before work.
note_fa: قبل از فعل اصلی و بعد از be می‌آید.

meaning_en: Very surprised and impressed.
example_en: I was amazed by her beautiful singing voice.
examples_extra: I was amazed by how fast she ran.
They were amazed to hear the good news.
note_fa: صفت ed- یعنی احساس فرد؛ amazing یعنی خودِ چیز.

meaning_en: A feeling of great surprise.

examples_extra: She looked at him in complete amazement.

meaning_en: Extremely good or wonderful.
example_en: The food at that restaurant is amazing.
examples_extra: We had an amazing time at the beach.

note_fa: صفت تشدیدی: very amazing گفته نمی‌شود.

meaning_en: Very surprising and difficult to believe.
example_en: It's amazing how fast children grow up.
examples_extra: It's amazing that nobody was hurt in the crash.
He told us an amazing story about his trip.

meaning_en: A high-ranking diplomat representing their country.
example_en: The ambassador met with the president.
examples_extra: She was appointed ambassador to Japan last year.
The ambassador welcomed the guests at the embassy.
note_fa: نماینده رسمی دولت در کشور دیگر.

meaning_en: A strong desire to achieve something.
example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
examples_extra: His ambition is to become a pilot one day.

note_fa: عبارت: sb's ambition to do sth.

meaning_en: Having a strong desire to succeed.
example_en: She is an ambitious student who wants to go to university.
examples_extra: She's ambitious and hopes to run the company.
They have ambitious plans for the new year.
note_fa: معنای مثبت «بلندپرواز»؛ گاهی منفی مثل pushy.

meaning_en: From America.
example_en: He is an American student.
examples_extra: He's American, but he lives in Toronto.
She enjoys watching classic American films at weekends.
note_fa: حرف اول بزرگ؛ هم صفت هم اسم ملیت.

meaning_en: A team sport played with an oval ball.
example_en: Many people watch American football on Sundays.
examples_extra: They play American football every Sunday morning.

note_fa: با توپ بیضی؛ متفاوت از football (soccer).

meaning_en: In the middle of several things or people.

examples_extra: She sat among her friends and laughed.

note_fa: برای سه‌تا یا بیشتر؛ between برای دوتا.

meaning_en: One of a group of similar things.
example_en: She is among the best students in her class.
examples_extra: He is among the best players in the team.
This book ranks among her finest works.
note_fa: یعنی «جزوِ» یک گروه: among the best.

meaning_en: A quantity of something.
example_en: Please pay the full amount.
examples_extra: A large amount of money was raised.
The amount of traffic surprised us all.
note_fa: amount of + غیرقابل شمارش؛ number of + قابل شمارش.

meaning_en: To examine something carefully to understand it.
meaning_fa: تحلیل کردن، تجزیه و تحلیل کردن
example_en: We need to analyse the data to find a solution.
examples_extra: Scientists will analyse the water samples tomorrow.
We need to analyse these results more carefully.

meaning_en: Used to connect words or phrases.
example_en: I like apples and bananas.
examples_extra: I bought bread and milk this morning.
She opened the door and walked inside.

meaning_en: And other similar things.
example_en: We discussed plans, budgets, and so on.
examples_extra: We need pens, paper, envelopes, and so on.
He likes jazz, blues, rock, and so on.

meaning_en: A strong feeling of being annoyed or unhappy.
example_en: He felt a lot of anger about the unfair decision.
examples_extra: He couldn't hide his anger any longer.
Her sudden anger surprised everyone in the room.
note_fa: از صفت angry با حذف y ساخته شده.

meaning_en: In an angry way.
example_en: She shouted angrily at her brother.
examples_extra: 'Leave me alone!' she shouted angrily at him.
He slammed the door angrily and left.
note_fa: قید حالت؛ معمولاً بعد از فعل.

meaning_en: Feeling strong displeasure or annoyance.
example_en: Don't be angry with me.
examples_extra: Don't be angry with me; it was an accident.
He got angry when the train was cancelled.
note_fa: عبارت: angry with sb / about sth.

meaning_en: A living thing that is not a plant.
example_en: A dog is a friendly animal.
examples_extra: The farm has many animals, including cows, sheep and horses.
Some animals sleep during the day and hunt at night.
note_fa: در کتاب با گوشت و بچه حیوانات آموزش داده شده (beef/calf).

meaning_en: The joint connecting your foot and leg.
example_en: I hurt my ankle playing football.
examples_extra: She twisted her ankle while running in the park yesterday.
He sat down and rubbed his sore ankle gently.
note_fa: در کتاب در بخش اعضای بدن (knee, wrist) آمده است.

meaning_en: A day remembering an important event from a past year.
example_en: Today is our wedding anniversary.
examples_extra: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary with a big party.
Our first anniversary is in June, so we booked a restaurant.
note_fa: wedding anniversary رایج‌ترین ترکیب است؛ جمع: anniversaries.

meaning_en: A public statement giving information.
example_en: The train station made an announcement.
examples_extra: The airport announcement said our flight was delayed by an hour.
She made an announcement about the new school rules this morning.
note_fa: در کتاب: اعلان‌های ایستگاه و فرودگاه (station announcement).

meaning_en: A feeling of slight anger or irritation.
example_en: His constant talking caused me great annoyance.
examples_extra: The constant noise from the street was a real annoyance for us.
To her annoyance, the train left two minutes before she arrived.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار irritation و disruption به‌عنوان اسمِ مشکل آمده.

meaning_en: Feeling a little angry or irritated.
example_en: I was annoyed by the loud music.
examples_extra: He was annoyed because his brother had borrowed his bike again.
I felt a little annoyed when the meeting started half an hour late.
note_fa: الگوی -ed برای احساس: annoyed یعنی خودت عصبانی هستی، نه annoying.

meaning_en: Making you feel a little angry or irritated.
example_en: That buzzing sound is very annoying.
examples_extra: That buzzing sound from the fridge is really annoying.
It is annoying when people talk loudly during a film.
note_fa: annoying یعنی «آزاردهنده» (علت احساس)؛ با annoyed اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: Happening once every year.
example_en: The school has an annual sports day.
examples_extra: Our school holds an annual sports day every June.
She pays an annual fee to use the tennis club.
note_fa: در کتاب با جشن‌ها و مراسم سالانه (مثل Shichi-Go-San).

meaning_en: A waterproof jacket with a hood.
example_en: He wore an anorak to stay dry in the rain.
examples_extra: Put on your anorak; it looks like it is going to rain.
He wore a warm anorak with a big hood for the mountain walk.
note_fa: در کتاب معنای slang هم دارد: خوره‌ی کامپیوتر (nerd/geek).

meaning_en: Suffering from an eating disorder causing extreme weight loss.
example_en: She became anorexic due to stress.
examples_extra: The doctor worried that the young model looked anorexic and too thin.
She became dangerously anorexic after months of eating almost nothing.

meaning_en: To reply to a question or call.
example_en: Please answer my question.
examples_extra: She picked up the phone and answered it quickly.
He did not know how to answer the teacher's difficult question.
note_fa: در کتاب با تلفن: answer the phone (جواب دادن).

meaning_en: A machine that records phone messages.
example_en: Leave a message on my answerphone.
examples_extra: I left a message on his answerphone because he was out.
Nobody answered, so the call went through to the answerphone.
note_fa: کلمه‌ای بریتانیایی؛ در آمریکا بیشتر voicemail می‌گویند.

meaning_en: A small insect that lives in large groups.
example_en: An ant carried a big crumb.
examples_extra: A long line of ants was carrying food across the kitchen floor.
The ant is small, but it can lift many times its own weight.
note_fa: در کتاب در بخش حشرات (bee, mosquito, fly) آمده است.

meaning_en: The coldest continent at the South Pole.
example_en: Antarctica is covered in ice.
examples_extra: Antarctica is the coldest and windiest continent on Earth.
Penguins live in Antarctica, around the South Pole.
note_fa: اسم قاره‌ها همیشه با حرف بزرگ: Antarctica (نه antarctica).

meaning_en: Program to protect computers from harmful viruses.
example_en: Install anti-virus software on your computer.
examples_extra: You should install anti-virus software to protect your computer.
The anti-virus software found and removed a dangerous virus.
note_fa: در کتاب: برنامه‌ای که جلوی ورود virus به کامپیوتر را می‌گیرد.

meaning_en: Opposed to war.
example_en: Many people joined the anti-war protest.
examples_extra: Thousands of people joined the anti-war march in the city centre.
She wrote an anti-war song about the pain of soldiers' families.
note_fa: پیشوند anti یعنی «ضد»: anti-war = ضد جنگ (در کنار antibiotic).

meaning_en: A medicine that kills bacteria and cures infections.
example_en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for my infection.
examples_extra: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for the chest infection.
You must finish the whole course of antibiotics, even if you feel better.
note_fa: anti یعنی ضد؛ برای عفونت باکتریایی است، نه سرماخوردگی ویروسی.

meaning_en: An old object of high value.
example_en: My grandmother has many beautiful antiques.
examples_extra: The museum bought an antique vase from the eighteenth century.
Her grandmother's beautiful ring is a very valuable antique.

meaning_en: A substance that stops germs from growing.
example_en: Clean the cut with antiseptic.
examples_extra: The nurse put some antiseptic on the small cut.
Hospitals use strong antiseptic to keep everything clean and safe.
note_fa: anti یعنی ضد؛ ماده‌ای که جلوی رشد میکروب را می‌گیرد.

meaning_en: Not wanting to spend time with other people.
example_en: He felt antisocial and stayed home.
examples_extra: He became quite antisocial after moving to the lonely farmhouse.
Staying in your room all weekend seems a bit antisocial.
note_fa: anti یعنی ضد؛ در کتاب در کنار antibiotic و anti-war.

meaning_en: A feeling of worry or nervousness.
example_en: She felt anxiety before the exam.
examples_extra: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first driving test.
Deep breathing can help reduce anxiety in stressful moments.

meaning_en: Feeling worried or nervous about something.
example_en: I feel anxious about my test.
examples_extra: The students looked anxious while they waited for the exam results.
He felt anxious about speaking English in front of the class.
note_fa: مترادف‌ها در کتاب: nervous؛ متضاد: calm.

meaning_en: In a worried or nervous way.
example_en: She waited anxiously for the results.
examples_extra: She waited anxiously for the doctor to call with the results.
'Is everyone all right?' he asked them anxiously.
note_fa: در کتاب با افعال گفتن: said anxiously (با نگرانی گفت).

meaning_en: Used to change the subject or end a conversation.
meaning_fa: به هر حال، در هر صورت
example_en: It's late, I should go anyway.
examples_extra: It was raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
Anyway, as I was saying, the film starts at eight.
note_fa: دو کاربرد در کتاب: عوض کردن موضوع و «به هر حال».

meaning_en: Used to add a more important point.
example_en: It's cold, but anyway, we need to leave now.
examples_extra: The trip was expensive, but anyway, the experience was worth it.
He was tired; anyway, the main thing is that he finished the race.
note_fa: برای اضافه کردن نکته مهم‌تر بعد از حرف‌های قبلی.

meaning_en: Used to return to a previous topic.
example_en: We talked about many things, but anyway, about your trip...
examples_extra: We got distracted by the news; anyway, back to our holiday plans.
Sorry for the interruption — anyway, where were we?
note_fa: برای برگشتن به موضوع قبلی بعد از انحراف بحث.

meaning_en: Except for; in addition to.
example_en: Apart from the rain, the trip was perfect.
examples_extra: Apart from the rain, the holiday was perfect.
Everyone came to the party apart from Yasmine, who was ill.
note_fa: دو معنا: «به‌جز» و «علاوه بر». کتاب: syn except for.

meaning_en: A set of rooms for living in.
example_en: We live in a small apartment.
examples_extra: They rent a small apartment near the city centre.
Her apartment is on the third floor of a large building.
note_fa: flat بریتانیایی است، apartment آمریکایی؛ هر دو یعنی آپارتمان.

meaning_en: To say sorry for something you did.
example_en: I must apologise for my mistake.
examples_extra: He apologised for arriving late to the meeting.
You should apologise to your sister for breaking her toy.
note_fa: الگو: apologise to someone / for something.

meaning_en: To say sorry about a reason or action.
example_en: He apologised for being late.
examples_extra: She apologised for the noise during the party last night.
I want to apologise for what I said yesterday.
note_fa: بعد از for اسم یا ing می‌آید: apologise for being late.

meaning_en: To express regret for a specific thing.
example_en: I apologise for the noise.
examples_extra: He apologised for his rude behaviour at dinner.
The company had to apologise for the mistake in the bill.
note_fa: sth یعنی something؛ الگوی رسمی‌تر عذرخواهی.

meaning_en: A statement saying you are sorry.
example_en: He made an apology for his behavior.
examples_extra: He wrote a letter of apology to his teacher.
She accepted his apology and they became friends again.
note_fa: در کتاب: I beg your pardon عذرخواهی رسمی‌تر است.

meaning_en: A punctuation mark showing possession or missing letters.
example_en: Use an apostrophe in "it's" for "it is".
examples_extra: Don't forget the apostrophe in the word 'can't'.
The teacher explained that the apostrophe shows possession in 'Sara's book'.
note_fa: در کتاب در فهرست کلماتِ بدتلفظ‌شده؛ نشانه مالکیت یا حذف حرف.

meaning_en: A small computer program for a phone.
example_en: I downloaded a new app for learning English.
examples_extra: I downloaded a new app for learning Spanish.
This weather app tells you if it will rain today.

meaning_en: To shock or horrify someone greatly.
example_en: The news of the accident appalled everyone.
examples_extra: The photos of the damaged village appalled everyone who saw them.
We were appalled by the rude behaviour of the guests.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار disgust و revolt؛ یعنی شوکه و منزجر کردن.

meaning_en: To be attractive or interesting to someone.
meaning_fa: جذاب بودن برای، مورد پسند بودن
example_en: The idea of a quiet holiday appeals to me.
examples_extra: Quiet countryside holidays in the mountains really appeal to me.
The idea of working abroad did not appeal to him at all.
note_fa: در کتاب: appeal to you یعنی برایت جذاب بودن.

meaning_en: To become visible or start to be seen.
example_en: A rabbit appeared from behind the bush.
examples_extra: A small boat appeared on the horizon as the fog cleared.
Stars begin to appear in the sky after sunset.
note_fa: در کتاب: appear in shops یعنی «منتشر/عرضه شدن».

meaning_en: To seem to be something.
example_en: She appears happy today.
examples_extra: She appeared calm, but I knew she was nervous inside.
The baby appeared to be sleeping peacefully in his cot.
note_fa: الگو: appear + صفت یا appear to be.

meaning_en: To be in a film, play, or book.
example_en: He will appear in the new movie.
examples_extra: The actor will appear in a new comedy film next spring.
She appeared in court as a witness to the accident.
note_fa: برای فیلم، نمایش و دادگاه: appear in court.

meaning_en: The way someone or something looks.
example_en: Her appearance changed after her haircut.
examples_extra: First appearances can be misleading, so get to know people first.
The old house had a strange appearance with its broken windows.
note_fa: در کتاب: landscape یعنی appearance یک منطقه.

meaning_en: A round fruit, often red or green.
example_en: I like to eat a red apple.
examples_extra: She eats an apple every morning before school.
The children picked red apples from the trees in the garden.

meaning_en: A sweet dessert made with apples in pastry.
example_en: My grandma makes the best apple pie.
examples_extra: We had warm apple pie with ice cream for dessert.
My grandmother makes the best apple pie in the family.

meaning_en: A formal request, often for a course or job.
example_en: Her application for university was successful.
examples_extra: She sent her university application before the deadline in January.
The job application asked for details of his previous work.
note_fa: در کتاب: submit your application یعنی ارسال درخواست.

meaning_en: A program designed for a specific task on a computer or phone.
example_en: I use a new application to edit photos.
examples_extra: This photo application lets you edit pictures on your phone.
Close the application before you turn off the computer.
note_fa: همان app؛ در کتاب: open an application.

meaning_en: A formal written request for a job.
example_en: I sent my application for the new job.
examples_extra: He filled in the job application form very carefully.
Her application for the teaching job was successful.
note_fa: ترکیب ثابت: fill in an application form.

meaning_en: To make a formal request for something, like a job.
example_en: You should apply for that manager position.
examples_extra: She decided to apply for a job at the local hospital.
You can apply for a student loan on the university website.
note_fa: در کتاب: apply for a job یعنی پر کردن فرم و درخواست.

meaning_en: To ask officially for something, like a job or visa.
example_en: I want to apply for a new passport.
examples_extra: He wants to apply for a visa to visit Canada.
They plan to apply for permission to build a new garage.
note_fa: sth یعنی something؛ برای شغل، ویزا، وام.

meaning_en: To choose someone officially for a job or position.
example_en: The president will appoint a new minister.
examples_extra: The club appointed a new manager at the start of the season.
She was appointed as head of the English department.

meaning_en: A planned meeting time with someone.
example_en: I have an appointment with the doctor at 3 PM.
examples_extra: I made an appointment with the dentist for Friday morning.
She missed her appointment because the bus was late.
note_fa: ترکیب ثابت: make an appointment (نه do).

meaning_en: A period of training for a skilled job.
example_en: He started an apprenticeship to become an electrician.
examples_extra: He did an apprenticeship as an electrician after leaving school.
The apprenticeship lasted three years and taught him the trade.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار companionship و partnership (پسوند -ship).

meaning_en: To come closer to something or someone.
example_en: The train is starting to approach the station.
examples_extra: As we approached the village, we saw smoke from the chimneys.
She approached the teacher to ask for help with her homework.

meaning_en: About; not exactly, but close to.
example_en: The journey takes approximately two hours.
examples_extra: The journey takes approximately two hours by train.
There were approximately fifty people at the concert.

meaning_en: Short for applications; programs for phones or computers.
example_en: I have many useful apps on my phone.
examples_extra: My phone has too many apps, so it runs slowly.
She uses travel apps to find cheap hotels.
note_fa: جمع app؛ در کتاب در بخش Your phone.

meaning_en: The fourth month of the year.
example_en: My birthday is in April.
examples_extra: My birthday is in April, just after the spring begins.
We are getting married next April in a small church.
note_fa: نام ماه‌ها همیشه با حرف بزرگ و با in: in April.

meaning_en: A person from an Arab country.
example_en: Many Arabs live in the Middle East.
examples_extra: He is an Arab from Jordan who now lives in Toronto.
Many Arabs speak both Arabic and English at home.
note_fa: در کتاب: an Arab مثل a Pole اسم ملیت است.

meaning_en: The language spoken in Arab countries.
example_en: She is learning to speak Arabic.
examples_extra: In Egypt and Saudi Arabia they speak Arabic.
She is learning Arabic because she wants to work in Dubai.
note_fa: در کتاب: زبان‌ها معمولاً مثل صفت مردم‌اند، ولی Arabic استثناست.

meaning_en: A person who shoots with a bow and arrow.
example_en: The archer aimed carefully at the target.
examples_extra: The archer pulled back the bowstring and aimed at the target.
In the film, a skilled archer protects the village.
note_fa: در کتاب: archer نه archerer (اشتباه رایج).

meaning_en: The sport of shooting with a bow and arrow.
example_en: Archery requires good focus and steady hands.
examples_extra: Archery is one of the oldest sports in the world.
She practises archery every weekend at the sports club.

meaning_en: A person who designs buildings.
example_en: My uncle is an architect; he designs houses.
examples_extra: The architect designed a modern glass building for the city.
She wants to become an architect when she finishes university.
note_fa: در کتاب: برای architect شدن باید architecture خواند.

meaning_en: The art and science of designing buildings.
example_en: I love studying old Roman architecture.
examples_extra: The old town is famous for its beautiful historic architecture.
He studied architecture for five years at university.

meaning_en: A technical abbreviation or specific term.
example_en: This ard is important for the system's function.
examples_extra: The entry 'ard' has no clear meaning in standard English.
We could not find 'ard' in any dictionary, so we left it blank.
note_fa: این واژه در کتاب یافت نشد و معنای مشخصی ندارد.

meaning_en: A specific part of a place or region.
example_en: This area has many beautiful parks.
examples_extra: This area of the city is very quiet at night.
The dining area is next to the kitchen in our flat.
note_fa: در کتاب برای بخش‌های خانه و شهر: living area، tourist area.

meaning_en: A large country in South America.
example_en: Argentina is famous for its tango dance.
examples_extra: Argentina is a large and beautiful country in South America.
Buenos Aires is the busy capital of Argentina.
note_fa: پایتخت: Buenos Aires؛ در کتاب در کنار Brazil و Chile.

meaning_en: From Argentina, a country in South America.
example_en: My friend is Argentinian and loves football.
examples_extra: He is a famous Argentinian football player in Europe.
We tried an Argentinian restaurant near our hotel.
note_fa: صفت‌های کشوری با (i)an: Argentinian، مثل Canadian.

meaning_en: To speak angrily because you disagree.
meaning_fa: بحث کردن، جر و بحث کردن
example_en: My brothers often argue about video games.
examples_extra: They often argue about small things, but they are good friends.
Please don't argue with your brother in front of the guests.
note_fa: در کتاب: argue یعنی have an angry discussion.

meaning_en: A reason or set of reasons for believing something.
example_en: His main argument was based on new data.
examples_extra: She gave a strong argument for building the new library.
His argument was clear, and everyone agreed with him.
note_fa: این معنا «دلیل» است، نه دعوا؛ با argumentِ بحث فرق دارد.

meaning_en: An angry discussion between people who disagree.
example_en: They had an argument about money.
examples_extra: They had a big argument about money last night.
The argument started over something very silly indeed.
note_fa: این معنا «دعوا» است؛ با argumentِ «دلیل» فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A reason or set of reasons to support an idea.
example_en: The lawyer presented a strong argument.
examples_extra: In your essay, give arguments for and against the idea.
That is a weak argument; you need better evidence.
note_fa: در مقاله‌نویسی: both sides of an argument.

meaning_en: Often likes to argue or disagree with people.
example_en: He is very argumentative and always wants to win.
examples_extra: He gets argumentative whenever anyone disagrees with him.
Try not to be so argumentative during the meeting.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار quarrelsome برای آدم‌های همیشه‌مخالف.

meaning_en: To happen as a result of something.
example_en: Problems often arise from poor communication.
examples_extra: Many problems arise from poor communication between managers.
Her interest in music arises from listening to her father's records.
note_fa: یعنی «ناشی شدن از»؛ گذشته: arose from.

meaning_en: The study of numbers, like adding and subtracting.
example_en: Basic arithmetic is taught in primary school.
examples_extra: Young children learn basic arithmetic at primary school.
He is good at arithmetic and can add large numbers quickly.
note_fa: در کتاب: reading, writing, arithmetic سه مهارت پایه مدرسه.

meaning_en: Related to arithmetic or numbers.
example_en: She made a small arithmetical error in her calculations.
examples_extra: The test included several difficult arithmetical problems to solve.
She solved the arithmetical puzzle in less than a minute.
note_fa: در کتاب با arithmetic و arithmetician (تأکید روی هجای سوم از آخر).

meaning_en: The part of your body from shoulder to hand.
example_en: I hurt my arm playing tennis.
examples_extra: He broke his arm while playing football last week.
She held the baby gently in her arms.

meaning_en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms.
example_en: I like to read in my comfy armchair.
examples_extra: Grandfather likes to sit in his favourite armchair by the fire.
She relaxed in the soft armchair with a good book.
note_fa: در کتاب: relax in an armchair.

meaning_en: Competition between countries to build more weapons.
example_en: The Cold War included a dangerous arms race.
examples_extra: The arms race between the two countries worried the whole world.
Historians often write about the arms race of the last century.
note_fa: در کتاب: رقابت کشورها برای قوی‌ترین ارتش.

meaning_en: A large group of soldiers fighting for a country.
example_en: My grandfather served in the army.
examples_extra: He joined the army when he was eighteen years old.
The army helped people after the terrible flood.
note_fa: در کتاب: join the army (عضو ارتش شدن).

meaning_en: Having a pleasant, strong smell.
example_en: The aromatic spices filled the kitchen with scent.
examples_extra: The kitchen smelled aromatic with fresh herbs and spices.
She lit an aromatic candle that filled the room with a sweet smell.
note_fa: در کتاب برای بوی خوش (herbs) در کنار fragrant.

meaning_en: In many directions; in a circle.
example_en: We walked around the park.
examples_extra: We walked around the lake in the early morning.
I'll meet you at around six o'clock outside the cinema.
note_fa: در کتاب: around یعنی about یا approximately (تقریباً).

meaning_en: To plan or organize something.
example_en: I need to arrange a meeting for next week.
examples_extra: We arranged to meet at the station at noon.
She arranged the flowers in a beautiful glass vase.
note_fa: در کتاب: arrange arrangement مثل organise organisation.

meaning_en: A plan or agreement made for something.
example_en: We made an arrangement to meet on Friday.
examples_extra: We made an arrangement to share the driving on the trip.
The flower arrangement on the table looked lovely.
note_fa: اسمِ arrange؛ در جدول verb/noun کتاب.

meaning_en: Police take someone to a station for a crime.
example_en: The police will arrest the thief.
examples_extra: The police arrested the thief outside the bank.
He was arrested for driving too fast through the town.

meaning_en: The act of coming to a place.
example_en: We waited for their arrival at the airport.
examples_extra: The arrival of the new baby made everyone happy.
We waited at the airport for the arrival of our friends.
note_fa: در کتاب بخش B Arrival فرودگاه؛ متضاد: departure.

meaning_en: To reach a place.
example_en: What time will you arrive home?
examples_extra: We arrived at the hotel just before midnight.
The letter arrived three days after she had left.
note_fa: الگو: arrive at/in؛ بعد از arrive حرف اضافه لازم است.

meaning_en: To reach a specific place or conclusion.
example_en: We will arrive at the station soon.
examples_extra: When you arrive at the airport, take a number ten bus.
We finally arrived at an agreement after hours of discussion.
note_fa: arrive at برای مکان‌های کوچک؛ arrive in برای شهر و کشور.

meaning_en: To reach a city or country.
example_en: They will arrive in London tomorrow.
examples_extra: They arrived in Paris early in the morning.
We arrived in Canada in the middle of winter.
note_fa: arrive in برای شهرها و کشورها (نه at).

meaning_en: Believing you are better or more important than others.
example_en: His arrogant attitude made him unpopular.
examples_extra: Nobody likes him because he is so arrogant about his money.
It was arrogant of her to think she knew everything.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار self-important و full of yourself.

meaning_en: Pictures, drawings, or sculptures.
example_en: I like to draw and make art.
examples_extra: Art is her favourite subject at school this year.
The museum has a large collection of modern art.

meaning_en: A building where art is shown to the public.
example_en: We visited a famous art gallery in Paris.
examples_extra: We spent the afternoon looking at paintings in the art gallery.
The new art gallery opened near the river last month.
note_fa: در کتاب در بخش Culture شهر (تئاتر، موزه).

meaning_en: Someone who enjoys and appreciates art very much.
example_en: My aunt is a true art lover.
examples_extra: As an art lover, she visits every new exhibition in town.
This beautiful book is a perfect gift for an art lover.
note_fa: در کتاب: loves painting and sculpture.

meaning_en: A piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.
example_en: I read an interesting article about space.
examples_extra: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the paper.
She wrote an article for the school magazine about travel.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 52 روزنامه؛ با article گرامری (a/an/the) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: Made by humans, not natural.
example_en: The flowers were artificial, but looked real.
examples_extra: The flowers looked real, but they were made of artificial silk.
This juice has no artificial colours or flavours.
note_fa: در کتاب: artificial chemicals (مواد شیمیایی مصنوعی).

meaning_en: A man-made replacement for a damaged hip joint.
example_en: She had an operation for an artificial hip.
examples_extra: After the operation, he needed an artificial hip to walk again.
The surgeon replaced her damaged hip with an artificial hip.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 29 بدن و سلامت.

meaning_en: A person who creates art.
example_en: My sister is a talented artist.
examples_extra: The artist painted a beautiful picture of the sea.
A famous artist is opening a new show at the gallery.
note_fa: در کتاب: solo artist یعنی خواننده/نوازنده تک.

meaning_en: Relating to art or having creative skill.
example_en: She has a very artistic eye for design.
examples_extra: She has a very artistic eye for colour and design.
The children made artistic decorations for the classroom.
note_fa: در کتاب: shows skill and imagination in creating things.

meaning_en: Subjects like history, literature, and languages.
example_en: I study arts at university.
examples_extra: She is studying arts subjects like history and literature.
The school offers both arts and science courses.
note_fa: در کتاب: arts subjects مثل English و history.

meaning_en: Creative activities like painting, music, and theatre.
example_en: She loves going to the theatre and enjoying the arts.
examples_extra: The government gives money to support the arts in our city.
She loves the arts, especially theatre and dance.
note_fa: جمع و با the: the arts یعنی همه هنرها (تئاتر، موسیقی...).

meaning_en: Activities like making things with your hands.
example_en: We did some arts and crafts at school.
examples_extra: The children enjoy arts and cras at school on Friday afternoons.
She sells her arts and cras at the weekend market.
note_fa: در کتاب: ساختن وسایل تزئینی با دست.

meaning_en: A section in a newspaper about art and culture.
example_en: I always read the arts page first.
examples_extra: I always read the arts page of the newspaper first.
Her play got a great review on the arts page.
note_fa: در کتاب: بخشی از روزنامه درباره هنر و فرهنگ.

meaning_en: Used to say why something happens.
example_en: As it was late, we went home.
examples_extra: As it was raining, we stayed at home all day.
She went to bed early as she was very tired.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 94؛ as یعنی because (چون).

meaning_en: Used to say something happens at the same time.
example_en: As I walked, I saw a bird.
examples_extra: As I was leaving the house, the phone rang.
He smiled as he opened the birthday present.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 92؛ as یعنی when (وقتی که).

meaning_en: Because of something that happened before.
example_en: He studied hard; as a result, he passed.
examples_extra: He worked hard all year; as a result, he passed the exam.
It rained all night. As a result, the streets were flooded this morning.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از so است؛ معمولاً اول جمله با کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: In a way that suggests something is true.
example_en: He looked as if he hadn't slept.
examples_extra: She talked as if she knew everything about the topic.
He looked at me as though I were a stranger.
note_fa: بعد از آن معمولاً فعل گذشته می‌آید: as if he were.

meaning_en: Provided that; only if.
meaning_fa: تا زمانی که، به شرطی که
example_en: You can go as long as you finish your homework.
examples_extra: You can go out as long as you finish your homework first.
I don't mind waiting as long as you are not late.

meaning_en: At the very moment; immediately when.
example_en: Call me as soon as you arrive.
examples_extra: Call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
The dog ran to the door as soon as it heard the bell.
note_fa: بعد از آن حال ساده می‌آید، نه آینده.

meaning_en: Also; too.
example_en: I want coffee, and tea as well.
examples_extra: She plays tennis and swims as well every week.
They gave us coffee and some cake as well.
note_fa: آخر جمله می‌آید، برخلاف also که وسط جمله است.

meaning_en: In addition to; and also.
example_en: She sings as well as plays guitar.
examples_extra: As well as tea, they served fresh fruit and cake.
She speaks French as well as English and Spanish.
note_fa: بعد از as well as اسم یا فعل ing می‌آید.

meaning_en: Used to compare two things that are equal.
example_en: He is as tall as his brother.
examples_extra: This book is as interesting as the one I read last year.
She runs as fast as her brother does.
note_fa: برای مقایسهٔ برابر دو چیز؛ صفت بین دو as می‌آید.

meaning_en: As soon as possible.
example_en: Please send the report ASAP.
examples_extra: Please call me back ASAP; the matter is urgent.
Send the report to the office ASAP today.
note_fa: فقط در متن‌های غیررسمی و پیام کوتاه به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: The largest continent in the world.
example_en: China is a big country in Asia.
examples_extra: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
Japan and China are both large countries in Asia.

meaning_en: From or relating to Asia.
example_en: She enjoys cooking Asian food.
examples_extra: She loves Asian food, especially Thai and Japanese dishes.
Many Asian countries celebrate the Lunar New Year.

meaning_en: To say something to get information.
example_en: I will ask my teacher a question.
examples_extra: Can I ask you a question about your job?
She asked the teacher for help with her homework.
note_fa: ask for یعنی «درخواست کردن»؛ ask تنها یعنی «پرسیدن».

meaning_en: To inquire what time it is.
example_en: I asked a stranger the time.
examples_extra: Excuse me, can I ask you the time?
He asked a stranger the time at the bus stop.
note_fa: مؤدبانه‌تر: Could you tell me the time, please?

meaning_en: To ask for directions to a place.
example_en: We asked a local the way to the museum.
examples_extra: We asked a shopkeeper the way to the museum.
Can you ask someone the way to the station?

meaning_en: To request something.
example_en: I will ask for a glass of water.
examples_extra: The child asked for a glass of water.
She asked for permission to leave the class early.
note_fa: بعد از for همیشه اسم می‌آید، نه فعل.

meaning_en: To request something from someone.
example_en: She asked her friend for help.
examples_extra: She asked him for help with the heavy box.
He asked his boss for a day off.

meaning_en: To ask someone for directions.
example_en: We asked a man the way to the park.
examples_extra: He asked a policeman the way to the hotel.
Don't be shy; just ask somebody the way.

meaning_en: To request an item or help from a person.
example_en: I will ask my mom for money.
examples_extra: She asked her best friend for some good advice.
He asked his teacher for extra time on the test.

meaning_en: To tell someone to perform an action.
meaning_fa: از کسی خواستن کاری انجام دهد
example_en: I asked him to close the door.
examples_extra: She asked him to open the window quietly.
The teacher asked us to read the first chapter.

meaning_en: A particular part or feature of something.
example_en: We discussed every aspect of the plan.
examples_extra: Every aspect of the plan needs careful thought.
The most difficult aspect of the job is the travel.
note_fa: جمع آن aspects است و معمولاً با of می‌آید.

meaning_en: A common medicine for pain or fever.
example_en: I took an aspirin for my headache.
examples_extra: Take an aspirin if you have a headache.
She always keeps some aspirin in her bag.

meaning_en: Expressing your opinions and needs strongly and confidently.
example_en: She is assertive and always speaks her mind.
examples_extra: Be assertive when you talk to your boss about a raise.
An assertive speaker can keep the audience's attention.
note_fa: معنی مثبت دارد؛ با aggressive (پرخاشگر) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: The process of judging or evaluating something.
example_en: The teacher gave us an assessment on our progress.
examples_extra: The teacher gave a fair assessment of my work.
Doctors made an assessment of his health before the operation.

meaning_en: Help or support given to someone.
example_en: Please ask for assistance if you need help.
examples_extra: Thank you for your assistance with the project.
She needed financial assistance to continue her studies.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از help است؛ در نامه‌ها و اعلان‌ها می‌آید.

meaning_en: Connected with something else.
example_en: There are risks associated with using new technology.
examples_extra: Smoking is strongly associated with serious health problems.
The risks associated with the trip were too high.
note_fa: همیشه با with می‌آید: associated with.

meaning_en: A health problem making it hard to breathe.
example_en: My friend has asthma and uses an inhaler.
examples_extra: My brother has asthma and uses an inhaler.
Cold air can make asthma much worse in winter.

meaning_en: Used to show an exact position or place.
example_en: I am waiting at the bus stop.
examples_extra: The train arrives at 7 o'clock in the evening.
She is waiting at the bus stop now.
note_fa: برای ساعت دقیق: at 5، ولی روزها on و ماه‌ها in.

meaning_en: Used in email addresses.
example_en: My email is john at example dot com.
examples_extra: My work email address is sara.karimi@mail.com these days.
Please send your reply to info@school.org by Friday.
note_fa: در ایمیل خوانده می‌شود: ali at gmail dot com.

meaning_en: In a specific place or location.
example_en: We met at the park yesterday.
examples_extra: We met at the restaurant near the park.
He works at a bank in the city centre.
note_fa: برای مکان مشخص: at the station، ولی شهرها in.

meaning_en: Used to emphasize a negative statement.
example_en: I don't like coffee at all.
examples_extra: I don't like coffee at all; I prefer tea.
She wasn't tired at all after the long walk.
note_fa: بیشتر در جمله‌های منفی و سؤالی می‌آید.

meaning_en: Responsible for a mistake or problem.
example_en: The driver was at fault for the accident.
examples_extra: The driver was at fault in the accident.
She admitted she was at fault and said sorry.

meaning_en: In the beginning; initially.
example_en: At first, I found the game difficult.
examples_extra: At first, I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
He was nervous at first, then he relaxed.
note_fa: بعد از آن معمولاً but یا now می‌آید.

meaning_en: In your own house or apartment.
example_en: I like to relax at home on weekends.
examples_extra: She stayed at home because she was ill.
We watched a film at home last night.
note_fa: the ندارد: at home، نه at the home.

meaning_en: Finally, after a long time.
example_en: At last, the train arrived.
examples_extra: At last, the train arrived after a long delay.
She passed the exam at last and felt very happy.
note_fa: حس انتظار طولانی دارد؛ قوی‌تر از finally.

meaning_en: Not less than; minimum.
example_en: You should drink at least eight glasses of water.
examples_extra: You need at least two hours to finish the work.
At least 50 people came to the party.

meaning_en: During the dark hours of the day.
example_en: Stars are visible at night.
examples_extra: Owls sleep during the day and hunt at night.
The streets are quiet at night in our town.
note_fa: the ندارد: at night، نه at the night.

meaning_en: Immediately; at the same time.
example_en: Please come here at once!
examples_extra: Come here at once; this news is very important.
She answered all of my questions at once.

meaning_en: In a situation where something bad might happen.
example_en: People who smoke are at risk of lung disease.
examples_extra: Smokers are at risk of serious heart disease.
Without a coat, you are at risk of catching a cold.
note_fa: بعد از آن فعل ing می‌آید: at risk of losing.

meaning_en: The final part or conclusion of something.
example_en: We will meet at the end of the street.
examples_extra: He waved goodbye at the end of the film.
Write your name at the end of the letter.
note_fa: با in the end (در نهایت) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: Now; right now.
example_en: I am busy at the moment.
examples_extra: I'm busy at the moment; can I call you back?
She is on holiday at the moment with family.

meaning_en: Happening simultaneously; concurrently.
example_en: They both spoke at the same time.
examples_extra: They both started speaking at the same time.
I can't listen to music and study at the same time.

meaning_en: Sometimes; occasionally.
example_en: He can be very quiet at times.
examples_extra: At times, I feel like quitting my job.
Life can be difficult at times, but keep going.

meaning_en: A person who competes in sports.
example_en: She is a great athlete and runs fast.
examples_extra: The young athlete won two gold medals easily.
Every athlete trained hard before the Olympic Games.

meaning_en: Strong, healthy, and good at sports.
example_en: He has an athletic build.
examples_extra: He has an athletic body from years of training.
She looks very athletic in her new sports clothes.

meaning_en: Sports like running, jumping, and throwing.
example_en: She loves watching athletics on TV.
examples_extra: Athletics includes running, jumping, and throwing events every summer.
She joined the school athletics team this year.
note_fa: اسم جمع است ولی فعل مفرد می‌گیرد: Athletics is popular.

meaning_en: A machine where you can get money.
example_en: I need to find an ATM to withdraw cash.
examples_extra: I need to stop at the ATM to get some cash.
The ATM near my house is open all night.

meaning_en: The feeling or mood in a place.
example_en: The restaurant had a lovely atmosphere.
examples_extra: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
There was a tense atmosphere in the meeting room.

meaning_en: To join one thing to another.
example_en: Please attach the file to your email.
examples_extra: Please attach your photo to the application form.
He attached the file to his email this morning.
note_fa: در ایمیل: attach a file یعنی «فایل ضمیمه کردن».

meaning_en: A file sent with an email message.
example_en: I sent the report as an attachment.
examples_extra: I sent the photos as an email attachment.
Open the attachment to see the full report.

meaning_en: A violent act against someone.
example_en: The police stopped the attack.
examples_extra: The city suffered a sudden attack at night.
The attack on the village shocked the whole country.

meaning_en: A sudden, strong start of a disease.
example_en: He had a sudden asthma attack.
examples_extra: He had an asthma attack and needed his inhaler.
She suffered a panic attack before the exam.
note_fa: با have می‌آید: have a heart attack.

meaning_en: To use violence against someone or something.
example_en: The dog tried to attack the mailman.
examples_extra: The dog attacked the stranger at the gate.
Critics attacked the government's new plan in the press.

meaning_en: To achieve or reach something difficult.
example_en: She hopes to attain her goals.
examples_extra: She attained the highest score in the class.
It took years to attain his goal of becoming a doctor.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از reach است؛ با اهداف بزرگ می‌آید.

meaning_en: Possible to achieve or reach.
example_en: Setting realistic and attainable goals is important.
examples_extra: Set small, attainable goals for yourself this month.
With hard work, success is attainable for everyone.

meaning_en: The act of achieving something.
example_en: Her academic attainment was impressive.
examples_extra: The prize was given for high attainment in science.
Her greatest attainment was finishing medical school with honours.
note_fa: رسمی است؛ در گفتار روزمره achievement رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: To try to do something, often difficult.
example_en: He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
examples_extra: His first attempt at skiing ended in a funny fall.
She attempted to climb the mountain alone last year.
note_fa: attempt to do یعنی «تلاش برای انجام».

meaning_en: To go to an event or place.
example_en: I will attend the meeting tomorrow.
examples_extra: Over 200 people attended the long wedding ceremony.
She attends English classes twice a week regularly.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از go to است: attend a meeting.

meaning_en: The act of being present at a place.
example_en: Good attendance is important for students.
examples_extra: Attendance at all classes is required this term.
The teacher took attendance at the start of the lesson.
note_fa: take attendance یعنی «حضور و غیاب کردن».

meaning_en: A space or room directly under the roof.
example_en: We store old boxes in the attic.
examples_extra: We found many old photos in the attic.
The attic is full of boxes we never open.
note_fa: فضای زیر سقف خانه؛ loft هم همین معنی را می‌دهد.

meaning_en: A way of thinking or feeling about something.
example_en: He has a positive attitude towards work.
examples_extra: She has a positive attitude towards her work.
His lazy attitude really annoyed all his colleagues.
note_fa: با to یا towards می‌آید: attitude to work.

meaning_en: To make someone interested in something.
example_en: The new store hopes to attract many customers.
examples_extra: The new park attracts hundreds of visitors every day.
Bright colours attract children's attention in TV adverts.

meaning_en: Make people notice something or someone.
example_en: The bright red car attracted a lot of attention.
examples_extra: The loud music from the street attracted everyone's attention.
She wore a red dress to attract attention at the party.
note_fa: با فعل‌های attract، draw و catch می‌آید.

meaning_en: A place or thing that people want to visit.
example_en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous tourist attraction.
examples_extra: The old castle is the main attraction of the town.
Many tourist attractions in the city were closed during the storm.

meaning_en: Pleasant or beautiful to look at.
example_en: She has a very attractive smile.
examples_extra: She has an attractive smile that everyone likes.
The shop window had an attractive display of clothes.

meaning_en: A dark purple vegetable, also called eggplant.
example_en: I like to cook aubergine with tomatoes.
examples_extra: Slice the aubergine and fry it in olive oil.
We had grilled aubergine with rice for dinner.
note_fa: در آمریکا به آن eggplant می‌گویند.

meaning_en: Reddish-brown color, usually for hair.
example_en: She has beautiful auburn hair.
examples_extra: She has beautiful auburn hair that shines in the sun.
His auburn beard made him easy to recognise.
note_fa: فقط برای رنگ مو به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: The people watching a play, concert, or film.
example_en: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
examples_extra: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the show.
A large audience watched the concert in the park.
note_fa: اسم جمع است ولی فعل مفرد می‌گیرد: The audience was happy.

meaning_en: A large room where people watch performances.
example_en: The school auditorium can hold 500 students.
examples_extra: The new school auditorium can hold 500 people.
We waited in the auditorium before the play began.

meaning_en: The eighth month of the year.
example_en: My birthday is in August.
examples_extra: My birthday is in August, the hottest month here.
Schools are closed during August in many countries.
note_fa: حرف اول بزرگ و قبل از آن in: in August.

meaning_en: Your mother's or father's sister.
example_en: My aunt lives in another city.
examples_extra: My aunt lives in Canada with her family.
We visited my aunt and uncle last weekend.

meaning_en: Region including Australia, New Zealand, and nearby islands.
example_en: Australasia is a beautiful part of the world.
examples_extra: Australasia includes Australia, New Zealand, and nearby islands.
They travelled all around Australasia for three months.

meaning_en: A large country and continent.
example_en: I want to visit Australia someday.
examples_extra: Australia is both a country and a continent.
Kangaroos live in the wild in outback Australia.

meaning_en: From Australia, or a person from Australia.
example_en: My friend is Australian.
examples_extra: He is Australian and comes from Sydney originally.
Two Australians joined our English class this term.

meaning_en: A person who writes books.
example_en: Who is the author of this book?
examples_extra: The author of this book is very famous.
She wants to become a children's author one day.

meaning_en: The people or groups in charge.
example_en: The authorities are investigating the accident.
examples_extra: The authorities closed the road after the accident.
Local authorities are building a new school here.
note_fa: همیشه جمع است: the authorities were، نه was.

meaning_en: The power to give orders or make decisions.
example_en: She has authority over her team.
examples_extra: Only the manager has the authority to approve refunds.
The police have the authority to stop any car.

meaning_en: A system that controls an aircraft automatically.
example_en: The plane flew on auto-pilot for hours.
examples_extra: The plane flew on auto-pilot for most of the journey.
He put the car in auto-pilot mode on the highway.
note_fa: گاهی کنایه‌ای به کار می‌رود: my brain was on auto-pilot.

meaning_en: A book about a person's life, written by that person.
example_en: I read a famous singer's autobiography.
examples_extra: She wrote her autobiography after retiring from acting.
His autobiography describes his difficult childhood in detail.
note_fa: auto یعنی «خود»: زندگی‌نامه‌ای که خود شخص نوشته است.

meaning_en: A famous person's signature.
example_en: I asked the actor for his autograph.
examples_extra: The singer signed autographs for her young fans.
He keeps a football with the player's autograph.

meaning_en: Without human control or thought.
example_en: The door opens automatically when you get close.
examples_extra: The doors open automatically when you approach them.
My computer saves my work automatically every five minutes.

meaning_en: The season between summer and winter.
example_en: The leaves turn red in autumn.
examples_extra: Leaves turn red and gold in autumn here.
We go walking in the hills every autumn.
note_fa: در آمریکا fall می‌گویند؛ اسم فصل با حرف کوچک نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: Able to be used or found.
example_en: Are there any rooms available for tonight?
examples_extra: This book is available in the school library.
Are you available for a meeting tomorrow morning?
note_fa: بعد از be می‌آید: is available.

meaning_en: A usual or normal amount.
example_en: The average temperature in July is 25 degrees.
examples_extra: The average temperature here in winter is minus five.
His test scores were above average this year.

meaning_en: Not special or unusual; typical.
example_en: He is an average student, not the best.
examples_extra: It was just an average day at work.
She is an average student with good friends.

meaning_en: Not especially beautiful or ugly.
example_en: She is an average-looking person.
examples_extra: He is just an average-looking man in his forties.
The small restaurant was average-looking from the outside.

meaning_en: To stay away from someone or something.
example_en: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
examples_extra: I try to avoid driving in heavy traffic.
She avoided answering the reporter's difficult questions yesterday.
note_fa: بعد از آن فعل ing می‌آید، نه to.

meaning_en: Knowing about something.
example_en: Are you aware of the problem?
examples_extra: Are you fully aware of the new rules?
She was aware of the danger but stayed calm.
note_fa: همیشه با of می‌آید: aware of.

meaning_en: Not here; to another place.
example_en: Go away and leave me alone.
examples_extra: He threw the ball far away into the garden.
She is away on holiday with friends this week.

meaning_en: At a distance from a place.
example_en: The shop is 5 miles away.
examples_extra: The beach is two miles away from here.
How far away is the nearest big hospital?
note_fa: فقط برای فاصله: two kilometres away.

meaning_en: Very bad or unpleasant.
example_en: The weather was awful yesterday.
examples_extra: The weather was awful all weekend, so we stayed home.
I feel awful about forgetting your birthday party.
note_fa: غیررسمی یعنی «خیلی بد»؛ با how می‌آید: How awful!

meaning_en: Difficult, embarrassing, or not graceful.
example_en: I felt awkward when I dropped my food.
examples_extra: There was an awkward silence after his joke.
She felt awkward meeting his parents for the first time.

meaning_en: Absent Without Leave; missing from duty.
example_en: The soldier went AWOL from the army.
examples_extra: The young soldier went AWOL during the night.
Two factory workers went AWOL and never returned.
note_fa: مخفف Absent Without Leave؛ بیشتر در زمینهٔ نظامی است.

meaning_en: To suddenly remove or stop something.
example_en: The company decided to axe 50 jobs.
examples_extra: The large company axed 200 jobs last year.
The TV show was axed after one season.
note_fa: در خبرها یعنی «حذف یا لغو ناگهانی».

meaning_en: Despite what was expected; in the end.
example_en: He passed the exam after all.
examples_extra: After all our hard work, we won the match.
He was angry, but he decided to stay after all.
note_fa: دو معنی: «در نهایت» و «با این حال».

meaning_en: Dessert; the sweet course at the end of a meal.
example_en: What are we having for afters?
examples_extra: We had chocolate cake for afters at my birthday dinner.
What are we having for afters tonight, Mum?

meaning_en: To influence or cause a change in something.
example_en: The weather can affect your mood.
examples_extra: The new law will affect thousands of workers.
Lack of sleep can seriously affect your memory.
note_fa: فعل است؛ با effect (اسم) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: A feeling of liking or love for someone.
example_en: She showed great affection for her cat.
examples_extra: She felt great affection for her kind grandparents.
The dog showed affection by wagging its tail.
note_fa: احساس محبت عمیق؛ رسمی‌تر از love است.

meaning_en: Showing love or liking.
example_en: He is a very affectionate child.
examples_extra: She gave her little son an aectionate hug.
They are a very aectionate and happy couple.

meaning_en: Bed and Breakfast; a place to sleep and eat breakfast.
example_en: We stayed in a nice B&B.
examples_extra: We stayed at a cosy B&B near the lake.
The small B&B served a big English breakfast.

meaning_en: A very young child.
example_en: The baby is sleeping now.
examples_extra: The tired baby is sleeping in her room.
They had a cute baby boy last spring.

meaning_en: A person who looks after children.
example_en: We need a babysitter for Saturday night.
examples_extra: We hired a kind babysitter for Saturday evening.
The babysitter put the kids to bed at eight.

meaning_en: First university degree after three or four years of study.
example_en: She earned her bachelor's degree in economics.
examples_extra: She earned her bachelor's degree in economics before starting her first job at a bank.
Many students finish a bachelor's degree in three or four years of full-time study.
note_fa: مدرک لیسانس — اولین مدرک دانشگاهی بعد از دبیرستان.

meaning_en: The part of your body opposite your stomach.
example_en: My back hurts after carrying heavy bags.
examples_extra: I have a pain in my back after sitting at the desk all day.
He hurt his back when he lifted the heavy box alone.

meaning_en: Moving first in one direction and then the opposite.
meaning_fa: عقب و جلو، این‌ور و آن‌ور
example_en: The children ran back and forth across the playground.
examples_extra: The boat rocked back and forth on the rough waves all night long.
He paced back and forth in the waiting room before the important interview.
note_fa: یعنی «جلو و عقب» — برای حرکت تکراری دوطرفه، مثل تاب خوردن.

meaning_en: With the back part where the front should be.
example_en: You're wearing your shirt back to front!
examples_extra: You put your T-shirt on back to front; the label is at the front.
She wore her sweater back to front and everyone in the class laughed.
note_fa: وقتی لباس را برعکس پوشیده‌ای — پشت لباس جلوست.

meaning_en: To support someone or something.
example_en: Can you back up my story?
examples_extra: I will back you up if the manager questions your decision.
