Her friends backed her up when she applied for the scholarship.
note_fa: از کسی یا چیزی حمایت کردن — مثل support.

meaning_en: To make a copy of computer data.
example_en: Always back up your important files.
examples_extra: Remember to back up your files before you update the computer system.
He backed up his photos on an external hard drive yesterday.
note_fa: از فایل‌ها کپی پشتیبان گرفتن — با make a backup هم‌معنی است.

meaning_en: To give support to a plan or person.
example_en: The government will back the new environmental project.
examples_extra: Most members backed the new plan at yesterday's long meeting.
The bank refused to back his business idea with a loan.
note_fa: مثل back up ولی رسمی‌تر و کوتاه‌تر.

meaning_en: A pain in your back.
example_en: I have a bad backache from sitting all day.
examples_extra: Sitting at a desk all day often gives me a terrible backache.
She stayed home because a bad backache made walking very difficult.
note_fa: بدون a می‌آید: have backache، مثل toothache و headache.

meaning_en: A plan or action has an opposite, bad result.
example_en: His clever plan backfired and caused more problems.
examples_extra: His joke about the boss backfired and made the whole team uncomfortable.
The new tax plan backfired when thousands of people protested in the streets.
note_fa: برنامه‌ای که نتیجه معکوس می‌دهد — مثل تفنگی که به عقب شلیک کند.

meaning_en: A bag carried on your back.
example_en: I put my books in my backpack for school.
examples_extra: She packed her clothes and books into a large red backpack.
The hikers carried their food and water in heavy backpacks.

meaning_en: A copy of computer data.
example_en: Make sure you have a backup of all your photos.
examples_extra: Always keep a backup of your important documents on a USB stick.
The company stores a daily backup of all customer data.
note_fa: اسمِ back up — یک کلمه و بدون فاصله نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: Salted meat from a pig, often eaten for breakfast.
example_en: I like to eat bacon and eggs for breakfast.
examples_extra: He eats eggs and bacon for breakfast almost every single morning.
The smell of fried bacon filled the small kitchen quickly.
note_fa: گوشت نمک‌سود خوک — معمولاً سرخ‌شده با تخم‌مرغ.

meaning_en: Not good; unpleasant or harmful.
example_en: The weather was really bad yesterday.
examples_extra: The weather was so bad that we stayed inside all day.
Smoking is bad for your health and your teeth.
note_fa: در کتاب با good آموزش داده می‌شود — متضاد مستقیم آن good است.

meaning_en: Not good at doing something.
example_en: I am bad at remembering names.
examples_extra: I am bad at remembering names, so I write them down.
He was always bad at maths but excellent at drawing.
note_fa: بعد از آن اسم یا فعل-ing می‌آید: bad at swimming.

meaning_en: Feeling unhappy or angry.
example_en: He is in a bad mood today.
examples_extra: He woke up in a bad mood and argued with everyone.
A cup of tea sometimes helps when I am in a bad mood.
note_fa: یعنی «بداخلاق» — با in می‌آید: in a bad mood.

meaning_en: A small piece of metal or plastic showing a symbol.
example_en: She wore a badge with her company logo.
examples_extra: The police officer showed us his shiny metal badge.
She wore a badge with the company logo on her jacket.
note_fa: نشان فلزی یا پلاستیکی — روی لباس نصب می‌شود.

meaning_en: In a poor or unsatisfactory way.
example_en: He sings badly, but he loves it.
examples_extra: The team played badly and lost the match three to nil.
He was badly hurt in the accident and stayed in hospital.

meaning_en: Seriously or severely affected.
example_en: The economy was badly affected by the crisis.
examples_extra: The coastal towns were badly affected by the terrible winter storm.
Small businesses were badly affected when the factory suddenly closed.

meaning_en: A sport played with rackets and a shuttlecock.
example_en: We play badminton in the park on Sundays.
examples_extra: We play badminton in the park every Sunday morning.
She bought a new badminton racket for the school tournament.
note_fa: با راکت و شاتل‌کیک — در زمین مخصوص (court) بازی می‌شود.

meaning_en: A container made of soft material, with a handle.
example_en: I carry my lunch in a small bag.
examples_extra: She carries her lunch to work in a small paper bag.
Please put your shopping bags by the front door.
note_fa: کیسه یا کیف نرم — handbag کیف دستی زنانه است.

meaning_en: A type of bread roll shaped like a ring.
example_en: I had a cream cheese bagel for breakfast.
examples_extra: I had a bagel with cream cheese for breakfast this morning.
The bakery sells fresh bagels with different tasty toppings.
note_fa: نان حلقه‌ای — معمولاً با پنیر خامه‌ای خورده می‌شود.

meaning_en: All the suitcases and bags you take on a trip.
example_en: We collected our baggage from the carousel.
examples_extra: We collected our baggage from the carousel after the long flight.
The airline lost his baggage, so he had no clothes for two days.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش است — baggage is درست است، نه baggage are.

meaning_en: The area at an airport where you collect your bags.
example_en: Let's go to baggage reclaim to get our suitcases.
examples_extra: Follow the signs to baggage reclaim to collect your suitcases.
We waited at baggage reclaim for almost an hour yesterday.
note_fa: محل تحویل چمدان در فرودگاه — بعد از passport control.

meaning_en: Clothes that are loose and hang loosely.
example_en: He likes to wear baggy jeans.
examples_extra: He wore baggy jeans and an old T-shirt to the party.
These trousers are too baggy; I need a smaller size.
note_fa: برعکس close-fitting — لباس گشاد و راحت.

meaning_en: A lot of something.
example_en: We have bags of time before the train leaves.
examples_extra: We have bags of time before the train leaves the station.
She has bags of energy and never seems to get tired.
note_fa: غیررسمی یعنی «خیلی زیاد» — معمولاً با there is می‌آید.

meaning_en: A long, thin loaf of French bread.
example_en: I bought a fresh baguette for dinner.
examples_extra: He bought a fresh baguette from the French bakery this morning.
We ate sandwiches made with a long crispy baguette.

meaning_en: Financial help given to a company in trouble.
example_en: The government approved a bailout for the struggling airline.
examples_extra: The government approved a huge bailout to save the failing banks.
Without a bailout, the airline would have closed within a month.
note_fa: کمک مالی دولت برای نجات شرکت ورشکسته.

meaning_en: A shop where bread and cakes are made and sold.
example_en: I bought fresh bread at the baker's.
examples_extra: I go to the baker's every morning to buy fresh bread.
The baker's on our street also sells delicious cakes.
note_fa: هم نانوا و هم مغازه نانوایی — با ’s یعنی «مغازه نانوا».

meaning_en: A place where bread and cakes are baked and sold.
example_en: The smell from the bakery is wonderful.
examples_extra: A new bakery opened near our house last month.
The bakery sells bread, cakes and sweet pastries every day.
note_fa: محل پخت و فروش نان و کیک.

meaning_en: Eating different healthy foods in the right amounts.
example_en: A balanced diet is important for good health.
examples_extra: Doctors say a balanced diet keeps you healthy and full of energy.
She follows a balanced diet with fruit, vegetables and enough protein.
note_fa: رژیم متعادل — نه خیلی زیاد، نه خیلی کم از هر چیز.

meaning_en: A platform outside a building, above the ground.
example_en: We sat on the balcony and enjoyed the view.
examples_extra: We sat on the balcony and watched the sunset over the sea.
Their flat has a small balcony with two chairs and a table.
note_fa: سکوی بیرون ساختمان، بالاتر از سطح زمین.

meaning_en: Having little or no hair on the head.
example_en: My uncle started to go bald in his thirties.
examples_extra: My uncle started going bald when he was only thirty years old.
The old man was completely bald and wore a warm hat.
note_fa: go bald یعنی «کچل شدن» — درباره موی سر.

meaning_en: A sport played with a ball.
example_en: Baseball is a popular ball game in America.
examples_extra: Football is the most popular ball game in our country.
The children played a ball game in the school yard.
note_fa: ورزشی که با توپ انجام می‌شود.

meaning_en: A type of dance performed on a stage.
example_en: We went to see a beautiful ballet performance.
examples_extra: We watched a beautiful ballet at the city theatre last night.
She has taken ballet lessons since she was five years old.
note_fa: رقص کلاسیک صحنه‌ای — از هنرهای نمایشی.

meaning_en: A type of classical dance.
example_en: She wants to be a ballet dancer.
examples_extra: The young ballet dancer practised for six hours every day.
A famous ballet dancer performed the main role that evening.
note_fa: کسی که رقص باله انجام می‌دهد.

meaning_en: The system of voting in an election.
example_en: They cast their ballot in the local election.
examples_extra: Citizens cast their ballot to choose the next president.
The secret ballot keeps everyone's vote completely private.
note_fa: رأی‌گیری مخفی با برگه — secret ballot.

meaning_en: A piece of paper used for voting.
example_en: Mark your choice clearly on the ballot paper.
examples_extra: Voters mark a cross on their ballot paper in the polling station.
Each ballot paper lists the names of all the candidates.
note_fa: برگه‌ای که رأی‌دهنده روی آن علامت می‌زند.

meaning_en: To officially forbid something.
example_en: The city decided to ban smoking in public parks.
examples_extra: The government decided to ban smoking in all public places.
Many schools have banned mobile phones during lessons.
note_fa: معمولاً با total می‌آید: a total ban on smoking.

meaning_en: A long, curved yellow fruit.
example_en: I eat a banana every morning.
examples_extra: She eats a banana with her breakfast every morning.
Monkeys love eating sweet yellow bananas from the tall trees.
note_fa: میوه زرد خمیده — جمع معمولی می‌گیرد: bananas.

meaning_en: A group of musicians who play music together.
example_en: My favorite band is playing tonight.
examples_extra: A local band played fantastic music at the wedding party.
He plays the drums in a rock band.
note_fa: گروه موسیقی — music غیرقابل‌شمارش است: great music.

meaning_en: A strip of cloth to cover an injury.
example_en: She put a bandage on her cut finger.
examples_extra: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around his injured finger.
She put a bandage on the small cut to stop the bleeding.

meaning_en: To hit something hard, making a loud noise.
example_en: He accidentally banged his head on the low doorframe.
examples_extra: He banged his fist on the table and shouted loudly.
Don't bang the door; the baby is sleeping upstairs.
note_fa: محکم زدن با صدا — با -ang حس ضربه: bang, clang.

meaning_en: A place where you keep or borrow money.
example_en: I need to go to the bank today.
examples_extra: I need to go to the bank to take out some money.
The bank is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
note_fa: محل نگهداری پول و گرفتن وام.

meaning_en: The land along the side of a river.
example_en: We sat on the river bank and watched the boats.
examples_extra: We sat on the bank of the river and watched the boats.
Trees grow thick along both banks of the wide river.
note_fa: با bank «بانک پول» فرق دارد — ساحل رودخانه است.

meaning_en: Money you keep in a bank.
example_en: I opened a new bank account last week.
examples_extra: She opened a bank account when she started her first job.
You can check your bank account balance on your phone.
note_fa: حساب بانکی — savings برای پس‌انداز، current برای خرج روزانه.

meaning_en: A person who works at a bank counter.
example_en: The bank clerk helped me with my money.
examples_extra: The bank clerk helped me fill in the long form.
Ask the bank clerk if you need to change some money.
note_fa: کارمند باجه بانک — در درس مشاغل.

meaning_en: A public holiday when banks and most businesses close.
example_en: We have a bank holiday next Monday.
examples_extra: Most shops are closed on a bank holiday in England.
We went to the seaside for the long bank holiday weekend.
note_fa: روز تعطیل رسمی که بانک‌ها بسته‌اند.

meaning_en: Money borrowed from a bank that you must pay back.
example_en: They took out a bank loan to buy a car.
examples_extra: They took out a bank loan to buy their first car.
He is still paying back the bank loan for his studies.
note_fa: وام بانکی — باید پس داده شود: pay back a bank loan.

meaning_en: A person who works in a high position at a bank.
example_en: My uncle is a successful investment banker.
examples_extra: The banker explained the different types of savings accounts.
Many bankers work long hours in the city centre.
note_fa: کارمند ارشد بانک — با bank clerk (کارمند باجه) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: The business of banks, managing money and finances.
example_en: She studied finance and now works in banking.
examples_extra: She works in banking and advises large companies on investments.
Online banking makes it easy to pay bills from home.
note_fa: صنعت بانکداری — I'm in banking یعنی «در بانکداری کار می‌کنم».

meaning_en: A place where you can buy and drink alcohol.
example_en: Let's meet at the bar for a drink.
examples_extra: We met our friends at a small bar near the station.
The bar was full of people watching the football match.

meaning_en: A long, solid piece of something, like chocolate.
example_en: I bought a bar of dark chocolate.
examples_extra: She broke off a piece from the bar of chocolate.
He bought a large bar of chocolate for his sister.
note_fa: تکه بلند و جامد — مثل a bar of soap.

meaning_en: A long, strong piece of metal or wood.
example_en: The prisoner tried to bend the metal bars.
examples_extra: The cage was made of thick iron bars.
He bent the metal bar with great effort.
note_fa: میله فلزی یا چوبی — با bar «مشروب‌فروشی» فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To prevent someone from entering a place.
example_en: Police bar protesters from entering the building.
examples_extra: The club barred him from entering after the fight.
Reporters were barred from the secret meeting room.
note_fa: منع ورود کردن — bar someone from a place.

meaning_en: (n) A meal cooked outdoors; (v) to cook outdoors.
example_en: We had a barbecue in the garden yesterday.
examples_extra: We had a barbecue in the garden on Saturday evening.
They barbecued chicken and corn for all the guests.
note_fa: هم مهمانی کباب‌پزی، هم فعل «کباب کردن در فضای باز».

meaning_en: The loud sound a dog makes.
example_en: The dog started to bark loudly at the stranger.
examples_extra: The dog barked loudly when the stranger knocked on the door.
Their neighbour's dog barks all night and keeps us awake.
note_fa: واق‌واق سگ — با bark «پوست درخت» فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To be wrong about the reason for something.
example_en: If you think I took your pen, you're barking up the wrong tree.
examples_extra: If you think I took your keys, you're barking up the wrong tree.
The police were barking up the wrong tree with that suspect.
note_fa: اشتباه حدس زدن — دنبال مقصر اشتباه گشتن.

meaning_en: A large, round wooden container for liquids.
example_en: They stored the wine in oak barrels.
examples_extra: The wine is stored in large wooden barrels underground.
Oil is usually shipped in heavy metal barrels.
note_fa: بشکه — چوبی یا فلزی، برای مایعات مثل oil و wine.

meaning_en: Land that is dry and cannot grow plants.
example_en: The desert is a barren and empty place.
examples_extra: The barren plains of Iceland grow almost no crops at all.
Years of drought left the fields dry and barren.
note_fa: زمین خشک و بی‌حاصل — در کتاب درباره ایسلند آمده.

meaning_en: A game played with a bat and ball.
example_en: My brother loves to play baseball.
examples_extra: Baseball is one of the most popular sports in America.
The boys played baseball in the park after school.
note_fa: با bat (چوب) و ball بازی می‌شود.

meaning_en: A room or area below the ground floor.
example_en: We keep old things in the basement.
examples_extra: We keep our old furniture in the dark basement.
The shop has a basement where they store extra stock.

meaning_en: To hit something very hard.
example_en: He accidentally bashed his knee on the table.
examples_extra: He bashed his knee against the sharp corner of the table.
The storm bashed the small boat against the rocks.
note_fa: محکم زدن — با -ash حس خشونت: smash, crash, bash.

meaning_en: Simple and necessary, forming the main part.
example_en: You need to learn basic English words first.
examples_extra: You need some basic English to travel in another country.
The hotel room was clean but very basic.

meaning_en: A bowl in a bathroom for washing hands.
example_en: Please wash your hands in the basin.
examples_extra: Wash your hands in the basin before dinner.
The bathroom basin was full of soapy water.
note_fa: کاسه روشویی حمام — در تصویر وسایل حمام.

meaning_en: A container made of woven material.
example_en: She put the fruit in a basket.
examples_extra: She put the dirty clothes in the laundry basket.
We carried our picnic food in a wicker basket.
note_fa: سبد بافته — در خرید اینترنتی your basket یعنی «سبد خرید».

meaning_en: A game where players throw a ball into a net.
example_en: They play basketball every Tuesday.
examples_extra: They play basketball on the school court every Friday.
Basketball players must be tall and very fast.

meaning_en: The lowest musical notes or sounds.
example_en: The song has a very strong bass line.
examples_extra: Turn up the bass on the speakers for a deeper sound.
He plays the bass in a jazz band.
note_fa: صدای بم — تلفظ /beɪs/، با bass «ماهی» فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A guitar that plays low musical notes.
example_en: He plays the bass guitar in a band.
examples_extra: She bought a red bass guitar for her birthday.
The bass guitar gives the band its deep rhythm.

meaning_en: A person who plays the bass guitar.
example_en: The band needs a new bass guitarist.
examples_extra: The bass guitarist stood at the back of the stage.
Our bass guitarist also sings in the band.

meaning_en: A wooden stick used for hitting a ball.
example_en: The baseball player swung his bat.
examples_extra: The player swung the bat and hit the ball far.
Cricket and baseball both need a bat and a ball.
note_fa: چوب ضربه‌زنی — با bat «خفاش» (حیوان) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Washing your body in a tub of water.
example_en: I like to take a warm bath at night.
examples_extra: She had a long hot bath after the tiring journey.
The children take a bath every evening before bed.
note_fa: have a bath — حمام کردن در وان.

meaning_en: To wash a baby in a small tub.
example_en: She is bathing the baby carefully.
examples_extra: She is bathing the baby in warm water.
Bathing a newborn baby needs great care and patience.

meaning_en: A room with a toilet and a bath or shower.
example_en: The bathroom is upstairs, next to my room.
examples_extra: The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.
Please clean the bathroom mirror after your shower.

meaning_en: A device that provides power for electronic things.
example_en: My phone battery is low.
examples_extra: My phone battery is dead; I need to charge it.
The toy needs two new batteries to work.
note_fa: باتری — در تصویر اجزای تلفن همراه.

meaning_en: A fight between armies or groups.
example_en: The soldiers fought a long battle.
examples_extra: The battle lasted for two hours before the soldiers retreated.
She is fighting a brave battle against her illness.
note_fa: نبرد — هم واقعی (war) هم مجازی: battle against illness.

meaning_en: A part of the sea partly enclosed by land.
example_en: We sailed into a beautiful, calm bay.
examples_extra: The ship anchored in the calm waters of the bay.
The Bay of Biscay lies between France and Spain.
note_fa: خلیج کوچک — با the می‌آید: the Bay of Biscay.

meaning_en: British Broadcasting Corporation, a UK public broadcaster.
example_en: I watch the news on the BBC.
examples_extra: The BBC broadcasts news programmes in many different languages.
She works as a reporter for the BBC in London.

meaning_en: To be going to do something very soon.
example_en: I was just about to leave when you called.
examples_extra: I was just about to call you when you rang.
We were about to leave when it started raining.
note_fa: «داشتیم که...» — کاری که همین حالا قرار بود انجام شود.

meaning_en: To find someone or something appealing.
example_en: He was attracted to her kindness and humor.
examples_extra: She was attracted to his kind and gentle personality.
Many tourists are attracted to the city's old streets.
note_fa: جذب شدن — درباره شخصیت، نه فقط ظاهر.

meaning_en: To come into life.
example_en: I was born in July.
examples_extra: He was born in 1957 in a small village.
The baby was born early yesterday morning.
note_fa: همیشه با was/were می‌آید: was born.

meaning_en: Pay attention to avoid danger or mistakes.
example_en: Be careful when you cross the road.
examples_extra: Be careful! There is a car coming round the corner.
Be careful what you say to her; she is upset.

meaning_en: Arrive or happen later than planned.
example_en: My flight was delayed by two hours.
examples_extra: Her train was delayed, so she missed the meeting.
Our flight was delayed by three hours because of fog.
note_fa: دیر رسیدن — با by می‌آید: delayed by two hours.

meaning_en: Want something very much.
meaning_fa: خیلی چیزی را خواستن، له له زدن
example_en: I'm dying for a cup of coffee right now.
examples_extra: I am dying for a cup of tea after the long walk.
The children were dying for something to eat.
note_fa: غیررسمی: «خیلی مشتاق چیزی بودن» — نه مرگ واقعی!

meaning_en: Be delayed or stopped.
example_en: I was held up in traffic this morning.
examples_extra: We were held up in traffic for over an hour.
The train was held up because of heavy snow.

meaning_en: Communicate with someone regularly.
example_en: Let's be in touch next week.
examples_extra: We have kept in touch since we met on holiday.
I will be in touch with you next week.
note_fa: در ارتباط بودن — با by می‌آید: in touch by email.

meaning_en: Like or be interested in something.
example_en: My brother is really into rock music.
examples_extra: My brother is really into jazz and old rock music.
She is into photography and takes her camera everywhere.

meaning_en: Like or be interested in something.
example_en: She is really into sports and plays every day.
examples_extra: He is into football and watches every match.
Are you into spicy food like curry and chilli?
note_fa: مثل be into — بعد از آن اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: Lose your job because there is no work.
example_en: Many workers were laid off from the factory.
examples_extra: Hundreds of workers were laid off when the factory closed.
He was laid off last month and is looking for work.
note_fa: اخراج به‌علت نبود کار — غیررسمی‌تر از be made redundant.

meaning_en: Lose your job because it's no longer needed.
example_en: He was made redundant after 20 years.
examples_extra: She was made redundant when the company cut fifty jobs.
Older workers are often made redundant first.
note_fa: بریتانیایی: شغلت حذف شده — مثل be laid off.

meaning_en: Be given the chance to work for a company.
example_en: She was offered a job at the new company.
examples_extra: She was offered a job in Paris and accepted it.
He was offered a job with a higher salary.
note_fa: پیشنهاد شغل گرفتن — was offered a job.

meaning_en: Be given the chance to do some work.
example_en: He was offered work for the summer.
examples_extra: I have been offered work in a small publishing company.
He was offered work on a building site last week.
note_fa: پیشنهاد کار گرفتن — work غیرقابل‌شمارش است.

meaning_en: Get a higher position in your job.
example_en: She was promoted to manager last month.
examples_extra: She was promoted to manager after only two years.
He hopes to be promoted before the end of the year.
note_fa: ارتقا گرفتن — با to می‌آید: promoted to manager.

meaning_en: Happen in a particular place or time.
example_en: The movie is set in New York City.
examples_extra: The story will be set in a small village in France.
The film will be set during the Second World War.
note_fa: «اتفاق افتادن در» — زمان یا مکان داستان.

meaning_en: Be familiar with something, so it feels normal.
example_en: I am used to waking up early.
examples_extra: It takes time to be used to getting up early.
She will never be used to the cold weather here.
note_fa: «عادت داشتن به» — بعد از آن فعل-ing یا اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: Sandy or stony land next to the sea.
example_en: We walked on the beach yesterday.
examples_extra: We spent the whole day swimming at the beach.
The beach was full of families enjoying the sunshine.
note_fa: ساحل شنی یا سنگی کنار دریا.

meaning_en: A vacation spent by the sea.
example_en: We want to go on a beach holiday.
examples_extra: They went on a beach holiday to Spain last summer.
A beach holiday is perfect for people who love swimming.
note_fa: تعطیلات کنار دریا — در درس انواع holiday.

meaning_en: A bird's hard mouth.
example_en: The bird used its beak to eat seeds.
examples_extra: The bird cracked the seed open with its strong beak.
Parrots have curved beaks for breaking hard nuts.
note_fa: منقار پرنده — در تصویر اعضای بدن پرندگان.

meaning_en: A long, strong piece of wood or metal.
example_en: The roof is supported by strong wooden beams.
examples_extra: The roof is held up by strong wooden beams.
Workers lifted the heavy steel beam with a crane.
note_fa: تیر چوبی یا فلزی ساختمان — با beam of light فرق دارد.

meaning_en: Small seeds eaten as food.
example_en: I like to eat beans for breakfast.
examples_extra: We had rice and beans for dinner yesterday.
She grows beans and tomatoes in her small garden.

meaning_en: A large, furry wild animal.
example_en: We saw a big bear in the forest.
examples_extra: A large brown bear walked slowly through the forest.
Bears sleep through the long cold winter.

meaning_en: Hair growing on a man's chin and cheeks.
example_en: My father has a long beard.
examples_extra: He grew a thick beard during the winter holidays this year.
I shave every morning, so I never keep a beard.
note_fa: «ریش» است؛ برخلاف hair معمولاً قابل شمارش: a beard، beards.

meaning_en: Win against someone in a game or fight.
example_en: Our team can beat them easily.
examples_extra: Our team beat the champions by three goals last night.
She always beats me when we play cards together.
note_fa: کتاب: Spain beat Poland (نه won Poland)؛ beat مستقیماً حریف می‌گیرد.

meaning_en: Very pleasing to the senses; lovely.
example_en: She is a beautiful woman.
examples_extra: The garden looks beautiful when the flowers bloom in spring.
She sang a beautiful song at the wedding last night.
note_fa: هم برای آدم هم برای چیز؛ pretty بیشتر برای زن‌ها و دخترها.

meaning_en: Make something more beautiful.
example_en: They want to beautify the park.
examples_extra: They want to beautify the old square with flowers and lights.
New curtains will beautify this dull living room.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از make beautiful؛ معمولاً برای مکان‌ها.

meaning_en: The quality of being beautiful.
example_en: Her beauty is admired by everyone.
examples_extra: The beauty of the sunset left everyone completely silent.
She saw the beauty in simple, everyday moments.
note_fa: اسم انتزاعی: the beauty of nature یعنی «زیبایی طبیعت».

meaning_en: A place where people go for hair and beauty treatments.
example_en: My sister works at a beauty salon.
examples_extra: She works in a beauty salon in the city centre.
The beauty salon on our street is busy every Saturday.

meaning_en: For the reason that.
example_en: I am happy because it's sunny.
examples_extra: We stayed home because the weather was really bad.
She cried because she was happy to see us.
note_fa: بعد از because جمله کامل می‌آید: because it was late.

meaning_en: As a result of; due to.
example_en: We stayed home because of the rain.
examples_extra: The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain.
She was tired because of the long journey home.
note_fa: بعد از because of اسم می‌آید، نه جمله: because of the rain.

meaning_en: A piece of furniture for sleeping on.
example_en: I go to bed at 10 PM.
examples_extra: I usually go to bed before eleven at night.
He was still in bed when I called this morning.
note_fa: go to bed یعنی به رختخواب رفتن؛ می‌گوییم in bed.

meaning_en: A room used for sleeping.
example_en: My bedroom is very cozy.
examples_extra: Her bedroom is on the second floor of the house.
The kids keep all their toys in the bedroom.

meaning_en: A small light next to a bed.
example_en: I turn on my bedside lamp to read.
examples_extra: A bedside lamp stands on the small table near his bed.
She read a book by the light of her bedside lamp.

meaning_en: A small table next to a bed.
example_en: My book is on the bedside table.
examples_extra: He keeps his glasses on the bedside table at night.
The bedside table has two small drawers for books.
note_fa: در انگلیسی آمریکایی به آن nightstand می‌گویند.

meaning_en: A flying insect that makes honey.
example_en: A bee flew into the garden.
examples_extra: A bee landed on the flower and collected sweet nectar.
Bees make honey and help the plants to grow.
note_fa: جمع آن bees است؛ wasp یعنی زنبور زرد.

meaning_en: Meat from a cow.
example_en: I like to eat beef with rice.
examples_extra: We had roast beef with vegetables for Sunday lunch.
This beef is very tender and full of flavour.
note_fa: گوشت گاو است؛ steak تکه‌ای از آن است.

meaning_en: An alcoholic drink made from grain.
example_en: He ordered a cold beer.
examples_extra: He ordered a cold beer after a long day at work.
Many people drink beer while watching football matches.

meaning_en: Excellent; the best of its kind.
example_en: Her new car is the bee's knees!
examples_extra: Everyone says this new phone is the bee’s knees.
His home-made pizza is the bee’s knees, I think.
note_fa: اصطلاح غیررسمی برای ستایش؛ همیشه با the می‌آید.

meaning_en: At an earlier time.
example_en: I need to finish this before lunch.
examples_extra: I had never seen the sea before that summer.
He told me the news before the meeting started.
note_fa: استرس روی هجای دوم است: beˈfore.

meaning_en: In front of; ahead of.
example_en: The car stopped right before the gate.
examples_extra: The letter B comes before C in the alphabet.
She stood before the mirror and fixed her hair.
note_fa: به معنی «جلوتر از»؛ در ترتیب و ردیف هم می‌آید.

meaning_en: At any time earlier than.
example_en: Call me before you leave.
examples_extra: Wash your hands before you eat your dinner.
She left the office before the rain started.
note_fa: بعد از آن جمله کامل می‌آید: before + جمله.

meaning_en: Ask for something in a very strong way.
example_en: The child begged for a new toy.
examples_extra: The child begged his mother to buy the toy.
They begged the manager for more time to finish.
note_fa: گذشته: begged؛ کالوکیشن کتاب: beg sb to do sth.

meaning_en: The start of something, a place or time.
example_en: The park is at the beginning of the street.
examples_extra: The beginning of the film was a little boring.
At the beginning of the lesson, she asked a question.
note_fa: «در آغاز»: at the beginning of the story.

meaning_en: Act in a particular way, good or bad.
example_en: Please behave well in class.
examples_extra: The teacher asked the children to behave during the trip.
Visitors must behave well inside the old museum.

meaning_en: The way someone acts.
example_en: His behaviour was very polite.
examples_extra: The teacher praised the children's good behaviour in class.
His strange behaviour worried his close friends.
note_fa: غیرقابل شمارش است: good behaviour (نه a behaviour).

meaning_en: From Belgium.
example_en: She loves Belgian chocolate.
examples_extra: My neighbour is Belgian and speaks three languages fluently.
Belgian chocolate is famous all over the world.
note_fa: هم صفت هم اسم: a Belgian یعنی «یک بلژیکی».

meaning_en: A strong feeling that something is true.
example_en: His belief in freedom is strong.
examples_extra: It is my belief that hard work always pays off.
Their beliefs about life were quite different from mine.
note_fa: از believe ساخته شده: believe in sth → belief.

meaning_en: To think something is true or real.
example_en: I believe his story is true.
examples_extra: I believe the news about the new airport is true.
Do you believe in ghosts and strange stories?
note_fa: با جمله: believe that؛ با باور کلی: believe in.

meaning_en: To think or suppose something.
example_en: I believe it will rain later.
examples_extra: I believe she will win the competition this year.
They believe the old house is worth a lot of money.
note_fa: به معنی «گمان کردن»؛ بعد از آن that می‌آید.

meaning_en: To have faith in something or someone.
example_en: Many people believe in democracy.
examples_extra: I believe in you, so please do not give up.
Many people believe in equal rights for everyone.
note_fa: کالوکیشن کتاب: believe in sth → belief.

meaning_en: A metal object that makes a sound.
example_en: The church bell rings every hour.
examples_extra: The school bell rings loudly at the end of lessons.
He rang the door bell twice before I answered.

meaning_en: To be owned by someone.
example_en: This book belongs to me.
examples_extra: This old bike belongs to my younger brother.
The painting belongs to a famous museum in Paris.
note_fa: به معنی مالکیت؛ هرگز passive نمی‌شود.

meaning_en: The things you own.
example_en: Please take all your belongings with you.
examples_extra: She packed all her belongings into one small bag.
Please do not leave your belongings on the bus.
note_fa: همیشه جمع است: belongings (نه a belonging).

meaning_en: In a lower place or position than.
example_en: The temperature is below zero today.
examples_extra: The temperature fell below zero during the night.
His photo is below the article on page ten.
note_fa: برای مکان و عدد: below zero یعنی «زیر صفر».

meaning_en: A strip of material worn around the waist.
example_en: He wears a black belt with his jeans.
examples_extra: He wore a black leather belt with his jeans.
Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.

meaning_en: A curve in a road or object. To curve.
example_en: Be careful, there's a sharp bend in the road.
examples_extra: The car slowed down at the sharp bend in the road.
The road bends to the right after the bridge.
note_fa: کتاب: a bend in the road؛ the road bends.

meaning_en: Under something, in a lower position.
example_en: The treasure was hidden beneath the old tree.
examples_extra: He found his phone beneath a pile of clothes.
The roots grow deep beneath the surface of the soil.

meaning_en: Next to someone or something.
example_en: She sat beside her friend.
examples_extra: She sat beside me on the long bus journey.
The hotel stands beside the river in the old town.
note_fa: یعنی «کنارِ»؛ با besides (علاوه بر) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: In addition to; also.
example_en: I don't want to go; besides, I'm tired.
examples_extra: I do not want to go, and besides, it is raining.
The price is too high; besides, the quality is poor.
note_fa: برای افزودن یک دلیل دیگر؛ بعد از آن کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: Used to add another reason.
example_en: I can't go; besides, I have no money.
examples_extra: For one thing, it is far; besides, I have no time.
She was ill, and besides, nobody told her the news.
note_fa: بعد از دلیل اول می‌آید تا دلیل دیگری اضافه کند.

meaning_en: In addition to something or someone.
example_en: Besides English, she speaks French.
examples_extra: Besides tea, they also served cakes and biscuits.
Besides English, she speaks French and Spanish well.
note_fa: به معنی «علاوه بر»؛ بعد از آن اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: The friend you like most.
example_en: My best friend lives next door.
examples_extra: My best friend and I have known each other since school.
She told her best friend the secret first.

meaning_en: The friend you like most.
example_en: My best friend helps me study.
examples_extra: He is my best friend and always helps me.
They are best friends and never argue for long.

meaning_en: A polite way to say good luck.
example_en: I send my best wishes for your exam.
examples_extra: Best wishes for your new job in the new city!
We sent our best wishes to the happy couple.
note_fa: پایان نامه یا ایمیل دوستانه: Best wishes.

meaning_en: A very popular book or product.
example_en: Her new novel became a bestseller.
examples_extra: Her first novel became a bestseller in just one month.
The book stayed on the bestseller list for a year.

meaning_en: So beautiful or charming it attracts you.
example_en: She had a bewitching smile.
examples_extra: The singer gave a bewitching performance that night.
They fell under the bewitching charm of the old city.

meaning_en: On the far side of something.
example_en: The mountains are beyond the river.
examples_extra: The farm lies beyond the river, near the old church.
The problem is beyond my understanding at the moment.
note_fa: به معنی «آن سویِ»: beyond the farm.

meaning_en: Happening twice a year.
example_en: The company holds a biannual meeting.
examples_extra: The company holds biannual meetings in June and December.
Our biannual sale starts next week with big discounts.
note_fa: دو بار در سال؛ با biennial (هر دو سال یک‌بار) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A vehicle with two wheels, you pedal it.
example_en: I ride my bicycle to school.
examples_extra: Somebody stole my bicycle from outside the station.
She rides her bicycle to work every morning.
note_fa: اشتباه کتاب: somebody stole my bicycle (نه robbed).

meaning_en: An offer to pay a price.
example_en: He made a high bid for the painting.
examples_extra: The company made a bid for the smaller rival firm.
Her bid of two million won the auction at last.
note_fa: در تیتر روزنامه‌ها یعنی «تلاش»: a takeover bid.

meaning_en: A person who thinks they are better.
example_en: Don't be a big-head, share your success.
examples_extra: Nobody likes working with a big-head like Tom.
She called him a big-head after his proud speech.

meaning_en: Thinking you are more important than others.
example_en: He is very big-headed about his new car.
examples_extra: Success made him big-headed and hard to talk to.
She is a little big-headed about her exam results.
note_fa: با proud فرق دارد؛ big-headed همیشه منفی است.

meaning_en: Larger in size.
example_en: I need a bigger shirt.
examples_extra: Have you got a bigger size in this shirt, please?
They need a bigger flat for their growing family.
note_fa: از big می‌آید: big, bigger, biggest.

meaning_en: A bicycle.
example_en: Let's ride our bikes to the park.
examples_extra: I hired a bike for the day and rode to the lake.
She goes to school by bike every day.

meaning_en: A two-piece swimsuit for women.
example_en: She wore a blue bikini at the beach.
examples_extra: She bought a new bikini for the beach holiday.
Her bikini was red with small white spots.

meaning_en: Involving two groups or countries.
example_en: They signed a bilateral agreement.
examples_extra: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
Bilateral talks between the leaders lasted three hours.
note_fa: از پیشوند bi (دو) آمده؛ یعنی دوطرفه.

meaning_en: Able to speak two languages well.
example_en: She is bilingual in English and French.
examples_extra: He grew up bilingual and speaks both languages well.
Our school offers a bilingual programme for young children.

meaning_en: A paper showing how much money you owe.
example_en: Can I have the bill, please?
examples_extra: Please check your bill before you pay at the hotel.
Can I have the bill, please? We are in a hurry.
note_fa: در رستورانِ بریتانیا the bill؛ در آمریکا the check.

meaning_en: A game played with balls and cues.
example_en: He enjoys playing billiards with friends.
examples_extra: They played billiards in the club every Friday evening.
Billiards is his favourite game after dinner.
note_fa: با اینکه جمع به نظر می‌رسد فعل مفرد می‌گیرد: Billiards is…

example_en: The company made a billion dollars.
examples_extra: The new bridge cost three billion dollars to build.
More than a billion people watched the final match.
note_fa: بعد از عدد s جمع نمی‌گیرد: three billion.

meaning_en: A container for rubbish.
example_en: Put the paper in the bin.
examples_extra: Please put the rubbish in the bin near the door.
The bin in the kitchen is full again.
note_fa: در آمریکا: trash can یا garbage can.

meaning_en: An optical device for seeing far away.
example_en: We used binoculars to watch the birds.
examples_extra: He watched the birds through his new binoculars.
The policeman observed the house through binoculars.
note_fa: همیشه جمع است: binoculars (نه a binocular).

meaning_en: A book about someone's life written by another person.
example_en: I read a biography of a famous singer.
examples_extra: She is reading a biography of the famous painter.
The new biography tells the story of his difficult childhood.
note_fa: زندگی‌نامه به قلم دیگری؛ خودِ شخص: autobiography.

meaning_en: The study of living things like plants and animals.
example_en: We learn about plants in biology class.
examples_extra: Biology is the study of living things like plants.
She passed her biology exam with a very good mark.

meaning_en: An animal with wings that can fly.
example_en: A small bird sang in the tree.
examples_extra: A small bird sat on the branch and sang sweetly.
Colourful birds flew over the lake at sunset.
note_fa: کتاب: A parrot is a bird (طوطی نوعی پرنده است).

meaning_en: The time when a baby or animal comes out.
example_en: My sister gave birth to a baby boy.
examples_extra: The birth of their first child made them very happy.
She gave birth to twins last spring.

meaning_en: Methods used to prevent a woman from becoming pregnant.
example_en: They discussed different types of birth control.
examples_extra: The clinic gives free advice about birth control methods.
She talked to her doctor about birth control options.
note_fa: کتاب آن را کنار blood pressure مثال اسم مرکب آورده.

meaning_en: The day you were born, celebrated each year.
example_en: Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day.
examples_extra: Happy Birthday! I hope you have a wonderful day.
We bought her a gift for her birthday.
note_fa: در روز تولد می‌گویند Happy Birthday نه Congratulations.

meaning_en: A card with a message given on someone's birthday.
example_en: I bought a nice birthday card for my friend.
examples_extra: He sent his grandmother a birthday card with flowers.
She wrote a funny message in the birthday card.

meaning_en: (US) A small, soft, round bread, often eaten with meals.
example_en: I had a warm biscuit with my breakfast.
examples_extra: She served warm biscuits with butter for breakfast.
He ate a biscuit with his soup at lunch.
note_fa: در آمریکا: نان نرم کوچک؛ در بریتانیا یعنی «بیسکویت».

meaning_en: A small piece or amount of something.
example_en: Can I have a bit of your cake?
examples_extra: She ate a small bit of chocolate after dinner.
A bit of kindness can change someone's whole day.
note_fa: «کمی»: کتاب a bit of news را مثال زده.

meaning_en: To cut or hold something with your teeth.
example_en: The dog tried to bite my hand.
examples_extra: The dog may bite if you pull its tail.
She will bite the apple and smile happily.

meaning_en: Having a strong, sharp taste, not sweet.
example_en: This coffee is very bitter.
examples_extra: The coffee was too bitter, so I added some sugar.
Dark chocolate can taste bitter, but many people love it.
note_fa: کتاب: bitter برای قهوه تلخ؛ sour برای لیمو.

meaning_en: In a very unhappy or angry way.
example_en: She cried bitterly after hearing the news.
examples_extra: She wept bitterly when she heard the sad news.
He complained bitterly about the long delay at the airport.
note_fa: کتاب آن را کنار angrily برای نقل گفتار آورده.

meaning_en: Very strange or unusual, often in a funny way.
example_en: He told a bizarre story about aliens.
examples_extra: The house had a bizarre design with round windows.
He told us a bizarre story about his strange dream.
note_fa: کتاب: a bizarre chair در برابر conventional.

meaning_en: Having very dark skin.
example_en: Many black people live in this city.
examples_extra: She wore a long black dress to the evening party.
The sky turned black before the heavy storm began.
note_fa: برای مو و پوست هم: black hair (کتاب).

meaning_en: In simple terms, clearly right or wrong.
example_en: Life is not always black and white.
examples_extra: Life is rarely black and white; most things are complex.
He sees every problem in black and white terms.
note_fa: اصطلاح: «خیلی واضح و بدون حالت میانی».

meaning_en: Coffee without milk or sugar.
example_en: I prefer to drink black coffee in the morning.
examples_extra: He drinks black coffee every morning without any sugar.
She ordered a large black coffee to take away.
note_fa: قهوه بدون شیر؛ مقابل آن white coffee است.

meaning_en: A dark mark around your eye from a hit.
example_en: He got a black eye playing football.
examples_extra: The boxer finished the match with a black eye.
She had a black eye from the accident yesterday.
note_fa: کتاب: کبودی دور چشم بعد از ضربه.

note_fa: با to می‌آید: delay the meeting؛ بدون تاخیر: without delay.

meaning_en: To remove something, like text or a file.
example_en: Please delete this old email.
examples_extra: Please delete the old files from your computer.
She deleted the message by mistake.
note_fa: در کامپیوتر: پاک کردن؛ delete the file (نه remove the file رسمی‌تر است).

meaning_en: Careful discussions or thoughts before making a decision.
example_en: The jury's deliberations lasted for hours.
examples_extra: After long deliberations, the committee reached a decision.
The jury began its deliberations this morning.
note_fa: جمع و رسمی؛ بحث و مشورت قبل از تصمیم‌گیری.

meaning_en: Easily damaged or needing careful handling.
example_en: The antique vase is very delicate.
examples_extra: Handle the glasses with care; they are very delicate.
This is a delicate matter, so speak gently.
note_fa: هم «شکننده» هم «حساس» (موضوع حساس: a delicate situation).

meaning_en: Having a very pleasant taste.
example_en: This cake is delicious!
examples_extra: The homemade soup was absolutely delicious.
They served a delicious cake at the party.
note_fa: فقط برای غذا؛ برای بو از fragrant و برای منظره از lovely استفاده کن.

meaning_en: Very pleased and happy.
example_en: I was delighted to hear your good news.
examples_extra: I was delighted to hear about your new job.
They were delighted with the wedding present.
note_fa: با to یا with می‌آید: delighted to meet you / delighted with the result.

meaning_en: Very pleasant and enjoyable.
example_en: We had a delightful time at the beach.
examples_extra: We spent a delightful evening at their house.
The garden is full of delightful flowers.
note_fa: صفت توصیفی (چیز/مکان لذت‌بخش)؛ delighted برای احساس انسان است.

meaning_en: To take goods or letters to a place.
example_en: The postman delivers mail every day.
examples_extra: The courier will deliver the package tomorrow morning.
He delivered an excellent speech at the conference.
note_fa: علاوه بر «تحویل»، deliver a speech یعنی سخنرانی کردن.

meaning_en: The act of taking goods to a customer.
example_en: My new shoes arrived with the delivery today.
examples_extra: Delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars.
We are expecting a delivery of new books today.
note_fa: free delivery یعنی ارسال رایگان؛ on delivery = هنگام تحویل.

meaning_en: A flat area of land at a river's mouth.
example_en: The Nile Delta is very fertile land.
examples_extra: The Nile delta is one of the most fertile regions.
Many birds live in the river delta.
note_fa: دلتای رودخانه؛ the Nile Delta (دلتای نیل).

meaning_en: A strong request or need for something.
example_en: There is a high demand for new phones.
examples_extra: There is a high demand for skilled workers.
The workers' main demand was better pay.
note_fa: با for می‌آید: demand for oil؛ در اقتصاد مقابل supply است.

meaning_en: To ask for something very firmly.
example_en: She demanded to know the truth.
examples_extra: The passengers demanded an explanation for the delay.
She demanded to see the manager immediately.
note_fa: قوی‌تر از ask؛ تقاضای جدی و محکم: demand an apology.

meaning_en: A system of government where people choose leaders.
example_en: Many countries strive for democracy.
examples_extra: They fought for democracy and free elections.
Democracy gives citizens the right to vote.
note_fa: صفتش democratic است؛ democracy یعنی نظام، democrat یعنی فرد.

meaning_en: A strong blue cotton fabric, used for jeans.
example_en: She was wearing a denim jacket.
examples_extra: Jeans are usually made of denim.
She wore a denim jacket with her dress.
note_fa: پارچه جین؛ به‌عنوان صفت هم می‌آید: denim jeans.

meaning_en: Having parts very close together; thick.
example_en: The forest was very dense and dark.
examples_extra: The jungle was too dense to walk through.
Dense fog covered the road this morning.
note_fa: کتاب: dense ≠ sparse (برای پوشش گیاهی)؛ dense forest = جنگل انبوه.

meaning_en: The degree to which something is dense.
example_en: The population density in the city is high.
examples_extra: The city has a high population density.
Oil has a lower density than water.
note_fa: تراکم؛ population density (تراکم جمعیت) پرکاربرد است.

meaning_en: (n) A hollow mark on a surface; (v) to make a dent.
example_en: My car got a small dent in the parking lot.
examples_extra: There is a small dent in the car door.
He dented the bumper while parking.
note_fa: اسم و فعل؛ فرورفتگی کوچک روی سطح (ماشین و...).

meaning_en: A doctor who takes care of teeth.
example_en: I have an appointment with the dentist.
examples_extra: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
You should see a dentist twice a year.
note_fa: با the می‌آید: go to the dentist (حتی اگر ناشناس باشد).

meaning_en: To say that something is not true.
example_en: He denied stealing the money.
examples_extra: He denied breaking the window.
The company denies the accusations.
note_fa: با that یا ing می‌آید: deny that... / deny doing...؛ یعنی انکار کردن.

meaning_en: To leave a place, especially to start a journey.
example_en: The train will depart from platform 3.
examples_extra: The train departs from platform three.
We will depart early tomorrow morning.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از leave؛ در فرودگاه: departures (پروازهای خروجی).

meaning_en: A large shop selling many types of goods.
example_en: We bought new clothes at the department store.
examples_extra: She bought the dress at a large department store.
The department store sells everything from food to furniture.
note_fa: فروشگاه بزرگ چندبخشی؛ department یعنی بخش/دپارتمان.

meaning_en: The act of leaving a place.
example_en: Our departure time is 10:00 AM.
examples_extra: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
His sudden departure surprised everyone.
note_fa: در فرودگاه: departures board (تابلوی پروازهای خروجی).

meaning_en: A screen showing flight or train departure times.
example_en: Check the departures board for your gate number.
examples_extra: Check the departures board for your gate number.
The departures board showed a one-hour delay.
note_fa: تابلوی اعلان پروازهای خروجی در فرودگاه؛ مقابلش arrivals board.

meaning_en: To be controlled or decided by something else.
example_en: Our picnic depends on the weather.
examples_extra: It depends on the weather whether we go out.
Our plans depend on getting the visa in time.
note_fa: کتاب: همیشه با on می‌آید؛ it depends on... (نه it depends of).

word: depend on sb [need sb to support you]
meaning_en: To need someone for support or help.
meaning_fa: متکی بودن به، وابسته بودن به
example_en: Children depend on their parents for everything.
examples_extra: Young children depend on their parents completely.
She depends on her friends for emotional support.
note_fa: یعنی «به کسی تکیه کردن»؛ dependent on یعنی وابسته به.

meaning_en: Needing someone or something for support.
example_en: Many elderly people are dependent on their families.
examples_extra: The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
He became dependent on his parents after the accident.
note_fa: با on می‌آید: dependent on...؛ آمریکایی‌ها dependent را /dɪˈpendənt/ می‌خوانند.

meaning_en: To force someone to leave a country.
example_en: The government decided to deport the illegal immigrants.
examples_extra: The government deported the illegal immigrants.
He was deported after his visa expired.
note_fa: اخراج از کشور؛ خانواده واژگانی: deportee / deportation.

meaning_en: The act of forcing someone to leave a country.
example_en: He faced deportation after his visa expired.
examples_extra: He faced deportation after breaking the law.
The deportation order was issued last week.
note_fa: عمل اخراج از کشور؛ deportation order یعنی حکم اخراج.

meaning_en: A person who has been forced to leave a country.
example_en: The deportee was sent back to his home country.
examples_extra: The deportee was sent back to his home country.
Deportees arrived at the border this morning.
note_fa: فرد اخراج‌شده؛ پسوند -ee یعنی کسی که عمل روی او انجام شده.

meaning_en: To remove a leader from power.
example_en: The army tried to depose the president.
examples_extra: The dictator was deposed in a military coup.
Rebels deposed the king after ten years.
note_fa: برکنار کردن رهبر از قدرت؛ رسمی و خبری.

meaning_en: (n) Money paid as a first part; (v) to put money in a bank.
example_en: I paid a deposit for the apartment.
examples_extra: We paid a deposit of five hundred dollars.
She deposited the cheque at the bank.
note_fa: پیش‌پرداخت (اجاره/خرید) یا واریز به بانک؛ اسم و فعل.

meaning_en: To make someone feel very sad.
example_en: Bad news can really depress me.
examples_extra: The rainy weather always depresses me.
Losing the match depressed the whole team.
note_fa: کتاب: This weather is getting me down = مرا افسرده می‌کند.

meaning_en: Feeling very sad and without hope.
example_en: She felt depressed after losing her job.
examples_extra: He felt depressed after losing his job.
She was depressed for weeks after the divorce.
note_fa: صفت -ed برای احساس انسان؛ depressed about/of می‌آید.

meaning_en: Making you feel sad and without hope.
example_en: The news was very depressing today.
examples_extra: It was a depressing film with a sad ending.
The empty streets looked depressing at night.
note_fa: صفت -ing برای چیز؛ depressing news = خبر ناراحت‌کننده.

meaning_en: A serious medical condition of feeling very sad.
example_en: He sought help for his depression.
examples_extra: She was treated for depression last year.
The Great Depression began in 1929.
note_fa: هم افسردگی (بیماری) هم رکود اقتصادی: the Great Depression.

meaning_en: The state of not having basic necessities.
example_en: Many people suffer from sleep deprivation.
examples_extra: Children in the area suffer from severe deprivation.
Sleep deprivation can seriously harm your health.

meaning_en: To prevent someone from having something important.
example_en: Don't deprive yourself of a good night's sleep.
examples_extra: War deprives children of a normal childhood.
They deprived him of his freedom.
note_fa: الگو: deprive somebody of something (محروم کردن از).

meaning_en: The distance from the top to the bottom.
example_en: We measured the depth of the swimming pool.
examples_extra: The depth of the pool is two metres.
We discussed the issue in depth.
note_fa: in depth یعنی «به‌طور عمیق/مفصل»؛ جمعش depths (اعماق).

meaning_en: A large, dry, sandy area with little water.
example_en: Camels can survive in the desert.
examples_extra: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
Camels can survive in the desert for days.
note_fa: اسم: /ˈdezət/؛ با فعل desert (ترک کردن، /dɪˈzɜːt/) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To leave someone or something without help.
example_en: He deserted his family and left town.
examples_extra: He deserted his family and moved abroad.
The soldiers deserted their posts during the battle.
note_fa: فعل: /dɪˈzɜːt/ یعنی ترک کردن؛ deserted (متروکه) صفت پرکاربرد است.

meaning_en: Empty of people; abandoned.
example_en: The streets were deserted late at night.
examples_extra: The streets were completely deserted at night.
They found a deserted house in the village.
note_fa: کتاب: deserted = no one on the streets؛ یعنی خالی از آدم.

meaning_en: (n) A plan for how something looks; (v) to plan something.
example_en: I like the design of your new car.
examples_extra: She studied fashion design in Milan.
The architect designed the new library.
note_fa: اسم و فعل؛ by design یعنی «عمداً/از روی قصد».

meaning_en: A person who plans how things look.
example_en: She works as a fashion designer.
examples_extra: The designer created a beautiful wedding dress.
He works as a graphic designer in Toronto.
note_fa: designer labels یعنی برندهای معروف لباس (کتاب: Versace و...).

meaning_en: A brand name of expensive, fashionable clothes.
example_en: She only wears clothes with a designer label.
examples_extra: She only wears clothes with designer labels.
Designer labels are often very expensive.
note_fa: برند لوکس لباس؛ کتاب: I like to buy designer labels.

meaning_en: (n) A strong wish; (v) to want something strongly.
example_en: He has a strong desire to travel the world.
examples_extra: He has a strong desire to travel the world.
She desired a better life for her children.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از want؛ desire to do / desire for something.

meaning_en: A table for working, often with drawers.
example_en: My computer is on my desk.
examples_extra: She keeps her laptop on the desk.
The teacher sat at his desk.
note_fa: میز تحریر/کار؛ front desk یعنی پذیرش هتل.

meaning_en: A computer that stays on a desk, not portable.
example_en: I prefer working on my desktop computer.
examples_extra: He prefers a desktop computer for video editing.
The office bought ten new desktop computers.

meaning_en: With great urgency or strong need.
example_en: He desperately needed help to finish the project.
examples_extra: She desperately needed money for the operation.
They were desperately trying to finish on time.

meaning_en: To dislike someone or something very much.
example_en: She despises people who are cruel to animals.
examples_extra: She despises people who are cruel to animals.
He despised the idea of cheating.
note_fa: کتاب: از dislike قوی‌تر؛ با اسم یا ing می‌آید: despise lying.

meaning_en: Even though; without being affected by.
example_en: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
examples_extra: Despite the rain, we enjoyed our walk.
He passed the exam despite being ill.
note_fa: با اسم یا ing می‌آید (نه جمله کامل)؛ despite the fact that + جمله.

meaning_en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.
example_en: What's for dessert tonight?
examples_extra: We had ice cream for dessert.
What would you like for dessert?

meaning_en: The place where someone or something is going.
example_en: Our flight's destination is Paris.
examples_extra: We finally reached our destination at midnight.
Paris is a popular tourist destination.
note_fa: مقصد؛ holiday destination یعنی مقصد سفر.

meaning_en: To damage something so badly it cannot exist.
example_en: The fire destroyed the old building.
examples_extra: The fire destroyed half of the forest.
A virus destroyed all his computer files.
note_fa: کتاب: a virus put on a computer to destroy files.

meaning_en: The act of damaging something so badly it cannot exist.
example_en: The earthquake caused widespread destruction in the city.
examples_extra: The war caused terrible destruction in the city.
The destruction of the forest worried environmentalists.

meaning_en: A house not joined to another house.
example_en: They live in a beautiful detached house with a garden.
examples_extra: They live in a detached house with a big garden.
A detached house is not joined to any other house.
note_fa: کتاب: detached house = خانه‌ای که به خانه دیگر نچسبیده؛ مقابل semi-detached.

meaning_en: Small facts or pieces of information about something.
example_en: Please give me all the details about the meeting.
examples_extra: Please send me the details of the meeting.
She gave us all the details about the trip.
note_fa: همیشه جمع به معنای «جزئیات»؛ in detail یعنی با جزئیات.

meaning_en: A police officer who investigates crimes.
example_en: The detective found new clues in the old case.
examples_extra: The detective solved the mystery in two days.
She loves reading detective novels.
note_fa: کارآگاه؛ detective story/novel یعنی داستان پلیسی.

meaning_en: Not letting anything stop you from doing something.
example_en: She is determined to finish her project on time.
examples_extra: She is determined to become a doctor.
They were determined not to give up.
note_fa: با to می‌آید: determined to succeed؛ یعنی مصمم.

meaning_en: To hate someone or something very much.
example_en: I detest waking up early on weekends.
examples_extra: I detest getting up early in winter.
She detests people who are cruel and dishonest.
note_fa: کتاب: قوی‌تر از dislike؛ با اسم یا ing: detest waiting.

meaning_en: To grow or change into something bigger or better.
example_en: The city plans to develop a new park.
examples_extra: The company developed a new app last year.
Children develop language skills very quickly.
note_fa: کتاب: develop = grow or change and become more advanced.

meaning_en: The process of growing or changing.
example_en: The new housing development will create many jobs.
examples_extra: The development of the vaccine took years.
There have been exciting new developments in AI.

meaning_en: A tool or machine for a specific purpose.
example_en: This new device helps monitor heart rate.
examples_extra: This device can translate fifty languages.
Mobile devices are not allowed in the exam.

meaning_en: Giving a lot of love and loyalty to someone or something.
example_en: She is a devoted mother to her children.
examples_extra: She is a devoted mother of three.
He is devoted to his work.
note_fa: با to می‌آید: devoted to her family؛ یعنی فداکار.

meaning_en: To identify an illness or problem.
example_en: The doctor diagnosed her with a common cold.
examples_extra: The doctor diagnosed him with diabetes.
It is hard to diagnose the problem without tests.
note_fa: تشخیص دادن (بیماری/مشکل)؛ diagnose somebody with something.

meaning_en: To make a phone call by pressing numbers.
example_en: Please dial the number carefully.
examples_extra: Dial 911 in an emergency.
She dialled his number twice.
note_fa: شماره گرفتن؛ در بریتانیا dialled با دو l نوشته می‌شود.

meaning_en: A form of a language spoken in one area.
example_en: People from that region speak a different dialect.
examples_extra: They speak a local dialect in the village.
She understands several Chinese dialects.
note_fa: گویش محلی؛ با accent (لهجه) فرق دارد: dialect واژه‌ها را عوض می‌کند.

meaning_en: Numbers you dial before a phone number for an area.
example_en: What's the dialling code for London?
examples_extra: What is the dialling code for London?
You need the dialling code before the number.
note_fa: کد منطقه تلفن؛ area code معادل آمریکایی آن است.

meaning_en: A conversation between two or more people in a play or film.
example_en: The film had very witty dialogue.
examples_extra: The film has some brilliant dialogue.
The two countries started a dialogue on trade.
note_fa: گفت‌وگو؛ در فیلم‌نامه: dialogue یعنی دیالوگ.

meaning_en: The distance across the center of a circle.
example_en: The diameter of the wheel is 50 centimeters.
examples_extra: The lake has a diameter of two kilometres.
Measure the diameter of the circle.
note_fa: قطر دایره؛ radius (شعاع) نصف diameter است.

meaning_en: A piece of soft material worn by a baby. (US English)
example_en: The baby needs a fresh diaper.
examples_extra: The baby needs a clean diaper.
She changed the baby's diaper.
note_fa: آمریکایی؛ در بریتانیا nappy گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: An illness causing frequent liquid bowel movements.
example_en: He had diarrhoea after eating bad food.
examples_extra: He had diarrhoea after eating street food.
Drink plenty of water if you have diarrhoea.

meaning_en: A book to write daily notes or appointments.
example_en: I write my appointments in my diary.
examples_extra: She writes in her diary every night.
He noted the appointment in his diary.
note_fa: دفتر خاطرات روزانه؛ dairy (لبنیات) را با آن اشتباه نگیر.

meaning_en: A country ruled by one person with total power.
example_en: The country was under a harsh dictatorship for decades.
examples_extra: The country lived under a military dictatorship.
The dictatorship ended after twenty years.
note_fa: کتاب: dictatorship = system run by a dictator.

meaning_en: To stop living.
example_en: My old dog died last year.
examples_extra: Her grandfather died peacefully in his sleep last year.
Many old trees die when the winter is too cold.
note_fa: «pass away» مؤدبانه‌تر از die است؛ شکل گذشته died و اسم death.

meaning_en: The food and drink a person usually eats.
example_en: Eating a healthy diet is important.
examples_extra: My doctor says I need a healthier diet with more vegetables.
Her diet is rich in fish and fresh fruit.
note_fa: «go on a diet» یعنی رژیم گرفتن؛ با healthy/unhealthy می‌آید.

meaning_en: Not the same.
example_en: These two shirts are very different.
examples_extra: My two sisters have very different personalities.
This jacket is different from the one I tried yesterday.
note_fa: با from می‌آید: different from (نه than در بریتانیایی).

meaning_en: Not the same colour.
example_en: Do you have this dress in a different colour?
examples_extra: The two cars are the same model but a different colour.
I painted my room a different colour from the living room.
note_fa: معنی تخصصی: «رنگ متفاوت»؛ همان different با کاربرد مشخص.

meaning_en: Not the same as something else.
example_en: My new phone is very different from my old one.
examples_extra: Her taste in music is different from mine.
The climate here is very different from my home country.

meaning_en: Using electronic technology, like computers.
example_en: We live in a digital age now.
examples_extra: Most people now keep digital copies of their photos.
The shop sells digital cameras and other electronic devices.
note_fa: مقابل analogue؛ digital camera, digital photo ترکیب‌های رایج‌اند.

meaning_en: A situation where you must choose between two difficult options.
example_en: I'm in a dilemma about which job to take.
examples_extra: He faced a dilemma: accept the new job or stay with his friends.
She was in a dilemma about whether to tell the truth.
note_fa: با face / be in می‌آید: «in a dilemma» یعنی دوراهی سخت.

meaning_en: Not intelligent or quick to understand.
example_en: He can be a bit dim sometimes.
examples_extra: He is not dim; he just needs more time to learn.
That was a rather dim question to ask in class.
note_fa: غیررسمی و کمی توهین‌آمیز؛ برای «نور کم» هم dim می‌آید.

meaning_en: The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.
example_en: What are we having for dinner tonight?
examples_extra: We always have dinner together at seven o'clock.
She invited all her friends to dinner last Saturday.
note_fa: «have dinner» یعنی شام خوردن؛ invite to dinner ترکیب رایج.

meaning_en: A document showing you have completed a course.
example_en: She received her diploma after two years of study.
examples_extra: She received her diploma after finishing the cooking course.
He has a diploma in business management from a London college.
note_fa: مدرک پایان دوره؛ با get/receive و in می‌آید.

meaning_en: An official representing their country abroad.
example_en: The diplomat worked to improve relations between countries.
examples_extra: The diplomat spoke to the press about the peace talks.
Many diplomats work at the United Nations in New York.

meaning_en: Going straight from one place to another.
example_en: Is there a direct train to the city center?
examples_extra: Is there a direct train from London to Paris?
He took a direct flight to save time.
note_fa: برای سفر: direct train/flight یعنی بدون توقف.

meaning_en: To tell actors what to do in a film.
example_en: Steven Spielberg directed many famous movies.
examples_extra: She wants to direct a film about her own childhood.
The famous director has directed more than ten films.
note_fa: کارگردانی کردن؛ director اسم فاعل و direction کارگردانی.

meaning_en: An instruction to your bank to pay money regularly.
example_en: I pay my electricity bill by direct debit.
examples_extra: I pay my electricity bill by direct debit every month.
Set up a direct debit so you never forget the payment.
note_fa: پرداخت خودکار ماهانه از حساب بانکی.

meaning_en: A private message sent directly to one person online.
example_en: I sent him a direct message on Twitter.
examples_extra: She sent me a direct message on Instagram last night.
Please don't share my direct messages with anyone.
note_fa: مخفف DM؛ پیام خصوصی در شبکه‌های اجتماعی.

meaning_en: To tell someone how to get somewhere.
example_en: Can you direct me to the nearest post office?
examples_extra: Could you direct me to the nearest train station?
The police officer directed the tourists to the museum.
note_fa: یعنی «راهنمایی کردن به سمت»؛ با to می‌آید.

meaning_en: The job of telling actors what to do.
example_en: His directing in the new play was excellent.
examples_extra: Directing a film takes many months of hard work.
He is studying directing at a famous film school.

meaning_en: The way something moves or points.
example_en: Which direction is the wind blowing?
examples_extra: Which direction is the city centre from here?
The wind changed direction during the night.

meaning_en: Instructions on how to get to a place.

examples_extra: Fragrant flowers filled the garden.
The fragrant tea comes from Sri Lanka.

meaning_en: a country in Europe.
example_en: Paris is the capital of France.
examples_extra: France is famous for its cheese and wine.
They spent their holiday in France.

meaning_en: honest and direct in what you say.

examples_extra: Let me be frank with you.
She gave a frank answer to the question.

meaning_en: the crime of deceiving someone for money.
example_en: He was arrested for credit card fraud.
examples_extra: He was arrested for credit card fraud.
The company was guilty of tax fraud.

meaning_en: the state of being free.
example_en: Everyone wants freedom.
examples_extra: People fought for their freedom.
The press should have more freedom.

meaning_en: a wide road for fast travel.
example_en: We drove on the freeway to the city.
examples_extra: The freeway was blocked after the accident.
We drove along the freeway for hours.

meaning_en: turn into ice because of cold.
example_en: The water will freeze overnight.
examples_extra: Water freezes at zero degrees.
The pipes freeze every winter.
note_fa: یخ زدن؛ گذشته: froze، اسم مفعول: frozen.

meaning_en: a part of a fridge that makes ice.
example_en: Put the ice cream in the freezer.
examples_extra: Put the ice cream in the freezer.
The freezer is full of meat.

meaning_en: very, very cold.
example_en: It's freezing outside today.
examples_extra: It's freezing outside; wear a warm coat.
My hands are freezing in this cold wind.
