meaning_en: from France.
example_en: I like French food.
examples_extra: She speaks French fluently at work.
We ate at a French restaurant.

meaning_en: thin pieces of fried potato.
example_en: I ordered a burger with French fries.
examples_extra: He ordered a burger with French fries.
French fries are my favourite snack.

meaning_en: how often something happens.
example_en: What is the frequency of these buses?
examples_extra: The frequency of buses here is very low.
What is the frequency of the radio station?

meaning_en: often.
example_en: He frequently visits his grandparents.
examples_extra: She frequently visits her grandmother.
Buses run frequently in the city centre.

meaning_en: recently made or picked, not old.
example_en: I bought fresh bread this morning.
examples_extra: The bakery sells fresh bread daily.
Let's start with a fresh sheet of paper.
note_fa: تازه؛ fresh air یعنی هوای آزاد.

meaning_en: clean air outside.
example_en: Let's go outside for some fresh air.
examples_extra: Open the window and get some fresh air.
We need some fresh air after the long meeting.

meaning_en: the day after Thursday.
example_en: I don't work on Friday.
examples_extra: We have a test on Friday.
Friday is my favourite day of the week.

meaning_en: a machine that keeps food cold.
example_en: Put the milk in the fridge.
examples_extra: The milk is in the fridge.
Our fridge broke down yesterday.

meaning_en: a machine with a fridge and a freezer.
example_en: We need a new fridge/freezer.
examples_extra: The fridge/freezer keeps food fresh for weeks.
We bought a new fridge/freezer last month.

meaning_en: a person you know and like.
example_en: She is my best friend.
examples_extra: She is my best friend.
He made many friends at school.
note_fa: دوست؛ make friends یعنی دوست پیدا کردن.

meaning_en: an invitation to connect on social media.
example_en: I sent him a friend request.
examples_extra: I sent her a friend request yesterday.
He accepted my friend request this morning.

meaning_en: the quality of being friendly.
example_en: Her friendliness made everyone feel welcome.
examples_extra: The staff impressed us with their friendliness.
Her friendliness made everyone feel comfortable.

meaning_en: kind and pleasant.
example_en: He has a friendly dog.
examples_extra: The neighbours are very friendly.
She gave me a friendly smile.

meaning_en: a relationship between friends.
example_en: Their friendship lasted many years.
examples_extra: Their friendship lasted for decades.
Friendship is more valuable than money.

word: frighten the life out of sb
meaning_en: to make someone very scared.
meaning_fa: کسی را تا حد مرگ ترساندن
example_en: That loud noise frightened the life out of me.
examples_extra: You frightened the life out of me!
The loud bang frightened the life out of the children.

meaning_en: feeling fear.
example_en: The child was frightened of the dark.
examples_extra: The little boy was frightened of the dark.
She was too frightened to speak.
note_fa: ترسیده؛ frightened of یعنی از چیزی می‌ترسد.

meaning_en: a small green animal that jumps.
example_en: A frog jumped into the pond.
examples_extra: A frog jumped into the pond.
Frogs croak loudly at night.

meaning_en: sometimes, but not often.
example_en: I visit my old school from time to time.
examples_extra: We meet from time to time.
From time to time, she visits her hometown.

meaning_en: the part that faces forward.
example_en: The car's front is damaged.
examples_extra: The car is parked at the front of the house.
Write your name on the front of the paper.

meaning_en: the main door of a house.
example_en: Please close the front door.
examples_extra: Someone is knocking at the front door.
She locked the front door before leaving.

meaning_en: thin white ice on surfaces when it's cold.
example_en: There was frost on the car windows.
examples_extra: There was frost on the car windows.
Frost covered the grass this morning.

meaning_en: to make lines on your forehead, showing anger.
example_en: She frowned when she heard the news.
examples_extra: She frowned when she heard the news.
The teacher frowned at the noisy students.

meaning_en: sweet food from trees or plants.
example_en: I eat a lot of fruit.
examples_extra: Eat more fruit and vegetables.
This fruit tastes very sweet.

meaning_en: a drink made from fruit.
example_en: I like orange fruit juice.
examples_extra: I drink orange fruit juice every morning.
The children love apple fruit juice.

meaning_en: a dish of mixed cut fruit.
example_en: I had fruit salad for dessert.
examples_extra: She made a fresh fruit salad.
Fruit salad is a healthy dessert.

meaning_en: feeling annoyed because you cannot do something.
example_en: I felt frustrated with the slow progress.
examples_extra: He felt frustrated with the slow internet.
She was frustrated by the lack of progress.

meaning_en: the feeling of being frustrated.
example_en: He felt a lot of frustration.
examples_extra: He expressed his frustration about the delays.
Tears of frustration filled her eyes.

meaning_en: cook food in hot oil.
example_en: I will fry some eggs for breakfast.
examples_extra: Fry the onions until they are golden.
They fry fish in hot oil.

meaning_en: a flat pan for frying food.
example_en: Heat the oil in the frying pan.
examples_extra: Heat the oil in a frying pan.
She cooked the fish in a large frying pan.

meaning_en: to achieve something you hoped for.
example_en: He wants to fulfil his dreams.
examples_extra: She worked hard to fulfil her dream.
The company must fulfil its promises.

meaning_en: making you feel happy and satisfied.
example_en: Teaching is a very fulfilling job.
examples_extra: Teaching is a very fulfilling job.
She found volunteering deeply fulfilling.

meaning_en: a feeling of happiness from achieving something.
example_en: She found great fulfilment in her work.
examples_extra: He found fulfilment in helping others.
The job gave her a sense of fulfilment.
note_fa: احساس رضایت از رسیدن به هدف.

meaning_en: thinking you are very important.
example_en: He's so full of himself.
examples_extra: Ever since the promotion, he's been full of himself.
Don't be so full of yourself.
note_fa: مغرور و خودپسند؛ محاوره‌ای و منفی.

meaning_en: the punctuation mark (.) at end of sentence.
example_en: Always end a sentence with a full stop.
examples_extra: Put a full stop at the end of the sentence.
In American English, a full stop is called a period.

meaning_en: working or studying for the whole working day.
example_en: She has a full-time job.
examples_extra: She has a full-time job at the bank.
He studies full-time at university.

meaning_en: no more rooms or seats available.
example_en: The restaurant is fully-booked tonight.
examples_extra: The hotel is fully-booked this weekend.
All flights are fully-booked for Friday.

meaning_en: the purpose or role of something.
example_en: What is the function of this button?
examples_extra: The function of the heart is to pump blood.
What is the function of this button?

meaning_en: basic and very important.
example_en: Education is a fundamental human right.
examples_extra: Honesty is a fundamental value.
There is a fundamental difference between them.

meaning_en: money provided for a particular purpose.
example_en: The project needs more funding.
examples_extra: The project received government funding.
They are seeking funding for the new school.

meaning_en: a ceremony for burying a dead person.
example_en: We went to the funeral.
examples_extra: Many people attended the funeral.
The funeral will be held on Monday.

meaning_en: the soft hair on an animal's body.
example_en: The cat has soft fur.
examples_extra: The cat has soft black fur.
Many animals grow thick fur in winter.

meaning_en: very angry.
example_en: She was furious about the delay.
examples_extra: She was furious about the mistake.
His furious voice scared everyone.

meaning_en: in a very angry way.
example_en: He shouted furiously at them.
examples_extra: He typed furiously on his keyboard.
They argued furiously about the bill.

meaning_en: things like chairs, tables, beds for a house.
example_en: We need new furniture for the living room.
examples_extra: The furniture in the living room is quite old.
They bought new furniture for their flat.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش است: the furniture is (نه are)؛ کتاب همین اشتباه رایج را یادآوری می‌کند.

meaning_en: covered with soft hair or fur.
example_en: The cat has soft, furry paws.
examples_extra: The cat is small and furry.
She wore a warm furry coat in winter.
note_fa: کتاب: furry = a thick sheepskin rug؛ یعنی پشمالو.

meaning_en: more; to a greater degree or extent.
example_en: Let's discuss this further tomorrow.
examples_extra: We need further information before we decide.
She walked further into the forest.
note_fa: به‌علاوه «بیشتر» یعنی «دورتر»؛ further to the letter یعنی «در ادامه نامه».

meaning_en: education after leaving school, not at university.
example_en: She plans to go to college for further education.
examples_extra: After school, he went into further education.
Further education includes colleges and training courses.
note_fa: تحصیلات بعد از مدرسه (غیردانشگاهی)؛ در بریتانیا: college.

meaning_en: referring to something previously mentioned, like a letter.
example_en: Further to our call, I'm sending the details.
examples_extra: Further to our phone call, I am writing to confirm.
Further to your email, here are the details.

meaning_en: in addition; also; used to add more information.
example_en: It was cold; furthermore, it started to rain.
examples_extra: The hotel is cheap. Furthermore, it is near the beach.
She is smart and, furthermore, very hard-working.
note_fa: ربط‌دهنده رسمی؛ در ابتدای جمله با کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: to worry or make a lot of unnecessary trouble.
example_en: Don't fuss over small problems.
examples_extra: She made a big fuss about the small mistake.
Do not fuss over the children so much.
note_fa: make a fuss (about) یعنی سروصدا/هیاهو به پا کردن.

meaning_en: time that has not happened yet.
example_en: What will you do in the future?
examples_extra: What are your plans for the future?
In the future, cars may drive themselves.
note_fa: in the future = در آینده؛ the future هم اسم است هم صفت (future plans).

meaning_en: to get or obtain something, often an advantage.
example_en: He hopes to gain more knowledge from the course.
examples_extra: She gained a lot of experience in that job.
The new policy helped them gain an advantage.
note_fa: کتاب: gain (time, an advantage)؛ یعنی به دست آوردن.

meaning_en: to be allowed to enter a place or institution.
example_en: She worked hard to gain admission to university.
examples_extra: He gained admission to a top university.
Students gain admission by passing an exam.

meaning_en: a very strong wind.
example_en: The ship faced a strong gale at sea.
examples_extra: A gale knocked down several trees last night.
The ship sailed through a terrible gale.
note_fa: کتاب: gale = very high wind؛ طوفان باد شدید.

meaning_en: an activity with rules that people play.
example_en: Let's play a board game tonight.
examples_extra: The children are playing a board game.
Football is the most popular game in the world.
note_fa: game یعنی «بازی»؛ match یعنی «مسابقه» (بین دو تیم).

meaning_en: a TV show where people play games to win prizes.
example_en: My grandma loves watching game shows.
examples_extra: She won a car on a TV game show.
Game shows are very popular on Friday nights.

meaning_en: a group of friends or people, sometimes criminals.
example_en: A gang of kids played in the park.
examples_extra: A gang of thieves robbed the bank.
He went to the cinema with his gang of friends.
note_fa: کتاب: gang of thieves (بار منفی)؛ برای دوستان غیررسمی و دوستانه است.

meaning_en: waste food and other unwanted things.
example_en: Please take out the garbage.
examples_extra: Please take out the garbage tonight.
The streets were full of garbage after the festival.
note_fa: آمریکایی؛ در بریتانیا rubbish؛ garbage can = سطل زباله.

meaning_en: an area of land next to a house, with plants.
example_en: We grow vegetables in our garden.
examples_extra: The children are playing in the garden.
She grows roses in her small garden.
note_fa: در بریتانیا حیاط خانه؛ در آمریکا yard رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: a shop selling plants, tools, and garden supplies.
example_en: I bought new flowers at the garden centre.
examples_extra: We bought some plants at the garden centre.
The garden centre also sells tools and seeds.

meaning_en: the activity of working in a garden.
example_en: My hobby is gardening.
examples_extra: Gardening is her favourite hobby.
He spends every weekend gardening.
note_fa: باغبانی؛ فعالیتی که با do نمی‌آید: go gardening.

meaning_en: a plant with a strong smell, used in cooking.
example_en: I like to add garlic to my food.
examples_extra: Add some garlic to the soup for flavour.
She does not like the smell of garlic.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش: a clove of garlic (یک حبه سیر).

meaning_en: a substance like air, used for fuel.
example_en: Burning too much gas causes pollution.
examples_extra: The house is heated by gas.
Turn off the gas before you leave.
note_fa: در آمریکا gasoline = بنزین؛ در بریتانیا petrol.

meaning_en: a long, deep cut in skin or a surface.
example_en: He had a gash on his arm from the fall.
examples_extra: He got a deep gash on his leg.
There was a gash in the wooden table.
note_fa: بریدگی عمیق و بلند؛ از cut جدی‌تر است.

meaning_en: a part of a fence or wall that opens.
example_en: Please close the gate behind you.
examples_extra: Please close the gate behind you.
The farmer opened the gate for the sheep.
note_fa: درِ حصار/باغ؛ door برای درِ ساختمان است.

meaning_en: a place in an airport where you get on a plane.
example_en: Our flight leaves from gate 10.
examples_extra: Our flight leaves from gate five.
Please go to gate twelve for boarding.
note_fa: گیت فرودگاه؛ boarding gate یعنی گیت سوار شدن.

meaning_en: to come together in a group.
example_en: Friends often gather at the cafe.
examples_extra: People gathered in the square to listen.
She gathered her books and left.
note_fa: هم «جمع شدن» هم «جمع کردن»؛ gather information یعنی اطلاعات جمع‌آوری کردن.

meaning_en: to look at something for a long time.
example_en: She gazed at the beautiful sunset.
examples_extra: She gazed out of the window for an hour.
He gazed at the stars in silence.
note_fa: نگاه طولانی و خیره؛ با at می‌آید: gaze at.

meaning_en: a person who is very interested in computers or science.
example_en: He's a computer geek, always coding.
examples_extra: He is a computer geek who loves coding.
The film club is full of movie geeks.
note_fa: کتاب: nerd, geek, anorak؛ خوره کامپیوتر/فناوری (کمی منفی).

meaning_en: valuable stones, or excellent things.
example_en: The article offered some real gems of advice.
examples_extra: The museum has a collection of rare gems.
This book is full of little gems of advice.
note_fa: کتاب: gems = jewels؛ معنای مجازی: نکته‌های ناب و ارزشمند.

meaning_en: a drug that makes you unconscious during an operation.
example_en: The patient received a general anaesthetic for surgery.
examples_extra: He had the operation under general anaesthetic.
The doctor gave her a general anaesthetic.
note_fa: بیهوشی عمومی؛ local anaesthetic یعنی بی‌حسی موضعی.

meaning_en: an election where people vote for a new government.
example_en: The country will hold a general election next year.
examples_extra: The general election will be held in May.
Millions voted in the general election.

meaning_en: a statement that is true in most situations.
example_en: It's a generalisation to say all cats hate water.
examples_extra: It is wrong to make a generalisation about all teenagers.
His generalisation was not supported by facts.
note_fa: تعمیم؛ make a generalisation یعنی تعمیم دادن.

meaning_en: to produce or create something, like electricity or ideas.
example_en: The new project will generate many jobs.
examples_extra: The dam generates electricity for the city.
The campaign generated a lot of interest.

meaning_en: all people born around the same time.
example_en: My grandparents belong to an older generation.
examples_extra: My grandparents belong to a different generation.
This phone is popular with the younger generation.
note_fa: نسل؛ generation gap یعنی شکاف نسلی.

meaning_en: differences in ideas between older and younger people.
example_en: There is often a generation gap in music tastes.
examples_extra: The generation gap causes many family arguments.
Music tastes show the generation gap clearly.
note_fa: شکاف نسلی؛ اختلاف دیدگاه پیر و جوان.

meaning_en: the quality of being kind and giving.
example_en: Her generosity helped many people.
examples_extra: Her generosity helped many poor families.
We thanked him for his generosity.
note_fa: سخاوت؛ generosity of spirit یعنی بزرگواری.

meaning_en: willing to give money, help, or time.
example_en: He is a very generous person.
examples_extra: He gave a generous donation to the charity.
She is generous with her time.
note_fa: کتاب: generous ≠ mean؛ با with/of می‌آید.

meaning_en: changing the genes of a living thing.
example_en: Genetic engineering has many ethical questions.
examples_extra: Genetic engineering can improve crop yields.
Many people worry about genetic engineering.
note_fa: مهندسی ژنتیک؛ دستکاری DNA موجودات زنده.

meaning_en: having genes changed for a specific purpose.
example_en: Some people worry about genetically modified foods.
examples_extra: Some shops refuse to sell genetically modified food.
Genetically modified crops grow faster.
note_fa: مخفف GM؛ یعنی تراریخته/دستکاری ژنتیکی شده.

meaning_en: not strong or severe; mild.
example_en: We had a gentle breeze today.
examples_extra: Be gentle with the baby birds.
A gentle breeze cooled the evening air.
note_fa: کتاب: gentle breeze (نسیم ملایم)؛ هم «آرام» هم «مهربان».

meaning_en: real, true, and not fake.
example_en: Is this a genuine antique vase?
examples_extra: This is a genuine leather bag.
She showed genuine interest in my work.
note_fa: کتاب: genuine Picasso ≠ fake؛ یعنی اصل و واقعی.

meaning_en: the study of the Earth's surface and features.
example_en: I like learning geography at school.
examples_extra: Geography is my favourite subject at school.
He knows the geography of Canada very well.
note_fa: جغرافیا؛ هم درس مدرسه هم «موقعیت جغرافیایی».

meaning_en: from Germany, or its language.
example_en: I am learning German.
examples_extra: She drives a German car.
Do you speak German at home?
note_fa: هم صفت (آلمانی) هم زبان آلمانی؛ a German یعنی یک آلمانی.

meaning_en: a country in Central Europe.
example_en: Germany is a beautiful country.
examples_extra: Germany is famous for its cars and beer.
She moved to Germany last year.
note_fa: آلمان؛ قبل از اسم کشورها the نمی‌آید (به‌جز موارد خاص).

meaning_en: to make a movement with your hand or head.
example_en: He gestured for me to come closer.
examples_extra: He made a friendly gesture with his hand.
She gestured for us to sit down.
note_fa: اسم و فعل؛ a kind gesture یعنی حرکت محبت‌آمیز.

meaning_en: to receive or obtain something.
example_en: I need to get some milk.
examples_extra: Did you get my message yesterday?
She gets a lot of emails every day.
note_fa: کتاب: get = got / got؛ پرکاربردترین فعل انگلیسی با معانی زیاد.

meaning_en: to find the correct answer to a question.
example_en: Did you get the answer to the math problem?
examples_extra: Did you get the answer to question five?
I always get the last answer wrong.
note_fa: get the answer یعنی «به جواب رسیدن».

meaning_en: to arrive at a place.
example_en: What time did you get home?
examples_extra: What time do you get home?
We got to the station late.
note_fa: get to + مکان یعنی رسیدن؛ get home بدون to می‌آید.

meaning_en: to become or start to be something.
example_en: It's getting dark outside.
examples_extra: It gets dark early in winter.
She got tired after the long walk.
note_fa: get + صفت یعنی «شدن»؛ غیررسمی‌تر از become.

meaning_en: to do or complete a task.
example_en: I need to get my homework done.
examples_extra: I must get my homework done tonight.
Did you get the shopping done?
note_fa: get sth done یعنی انجام دادن کار.

meaning_en: to go and bring something back.
example_en: Can you get me a glass of water?
examples_extra: Could you get my glasses from the kitchen?
I will get the children from school.
note_fa: کتاب: fetch = go and get؛ یعنی رفتن و آوردن.

meaning_en: to travel by bus.
example_en: I get a bus to school every day.
examples_extra: I get a bus to work every morning.
Did you get a bus or walk here?
note_fa: سوار اتوبوس شدن؛ take/catch a bus هم درست است.

meaning_en: to earn a qualification from a university.
example_en: She wants to get a degree in art.
examples_extra: She hopes to get a degree in medicine.
Where did you get your degree?
note_fa: مدرک گرفتن؛ get/do a degree (کتاب: do an exam, pass exams).

meaning_en: to find work and start earning money.
example_en: He hopes to get a job soon.
examples_extra: He got a job at a bank last month.
It is hard to get a job these days.
note_fa: کار پیدا کردن؛ get a job (نه find a job رسمی‌تر است اما هر دو درست).

meaning_en: to travel by train.
example_en: We will get a train to the city.
examples_extra: We get a train to the city centre.
Did you get a train or drive?
note_fa: سوار قطار شدن؛ take a train رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: to make someone understand something.
example_en: It's hard to get my ideas across.
examples_extra: He could not get his ideas across clearly.
Try to get your message across simply.
note_fa: کتاب: put across = communicate؛ یعنی مطلب را رساندن/فهماندن.

meaning_en: to try to say something, often indirectly.
example_en: What are you trying to get at?
examples_extra: What are you getting at with these questions?
I do not understand what she is getting at.
note_fa: یعنی «منظورت چیست»؛ غیررسمی: What are you getting at?

meaning_en: to go somewhere for a holiday or break.
example_en: We need to get away for a few days.
examples_extra: We want to get away for the weekend.
They got away to the mountains.
note_fa: به سفر کوتاه رفتن؛ getaway (اسم) یعنی سفر کوتاه.

meaning_en: to escape from a person or place.
example_en: The thief managed to get away.
examples_extra: The thief got away before the police arrived.
She managed to get away from the crowd.
note_fa: فرار کردن؛ get away with یعنی «از مجازات فرار کردن».

meaning_en: to return to a place.
example_en: What time did you get back home?
examples_extra: What time do you get back home?
We got back late last night.
note_fa: برگشتن؛ get back to یعنی برگشتن به (کار/مکان).

meaning_en: to fail to do something on time.
example_en: I got behind with my studies.
examples_extra: He got behind with his rent payments.
Do not get behind with your studies.
note_fa: از برنامه عقب افتادن؛ get behind with work (کتاب).

meaning_en: to improve or recover from illness.
example_en: I hope you get better soon.

meaning_en: the worst possible outcome or situation.
example_en: We must plan for the worst-case scenario, just in case.
examples_extra: Plan for the worst-case scenario.
The dreaded worst-case scenario finally happened.

meaning_en: having no value, importance, or use.
example_en: The old painting was deemed worthless by the expert.
examples_extra: The old coins are worthless.
His useless advice proved completely worthless.

meaning_en: deserving of; suitable for.
example_en: Her brave actions were truly praise-worthy.
examples_extra: The film is truly Oscar-worthy.
It was a truly prize-worthy effort.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ پسوند «لایق»: newsworthy، trustworthy.

meaning_en: to write a detailed report or description.
example_en: Students need to write up their lab experiments.
examples_extra: She will write up the report.
He will write up his notes.

meaning_en: incorrect or not right.
example_en: You got the answer wrong; try again.
examples_extra: Your answer is completely wrong.
She accidentally took the wrong bus.

meaning_en: in an incorrect or unjust manner.
example_en: Man wrongly accused of theft released.
examples_extra: She was wrongly accused yesterday.
He spelled my name wrongly again.

meaning_en: using dry, mocking humor; ironic.
example_en: He gave a wry smile, acknowledging the irony.
examples_extra: She gave a wry smile.
His wry humour made us laugh.
note_fa: کتاب: wry comedy؛ طنز خشک و کنایه‌آمیز.

meaning_en: forming adjectives meaning 'full of' or 'like'.
example_en: The weather was quite cloudy and windy today.
examples_extra: The -y suffix forms adjectives.
Words with -y sound informal.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ پسوند صفت‌ساز: rainy، sandy.

meaning_en: to have a strong desire for something.
example_en: She yearned for a simpler life in the countryside.
examples_extra: She yearns deeply for freedom.
He yearned desperately to go home.
note_fa: کتاب: yearn to be on her own؛ اشتیاق شدید.

meaning_en: to shout loudly, often in anger or excitement.
example_en: Don't yell at me; I can hear you.
examples_extra: She yelled loudly for help.
He yelled angrily across the street.

meaning_en: a rude, aggressive, or badly behaved young man.
example_en: Police arrested a yob for vandalism last night.
examples_extra: Drunk yobs smashed the windows.
A gang of yobs gathered outside.
note_fa: غیررسمی بریتانیایی: جوان شرور و بی‌تربیت.

meaning_en: certainly; absolutely; yes, of course.
example_en: "Are you coming?" "You bet! I wouldn't miss it."
examples_extra: You bet! I will be there.
Can you help? You bet!

meaning_en: an expression of disbelief or surprise.
example_en: "I won the lottery!" "You must be joking!"
examples_extra: You must be joking! Really?
You want a thousand? You must be joking!
note_fa: کتاب: You must be joking!؛ ابراز ناباوری.

meaning_en: I don't understand what you mean anymore.
example_en: When you started talking about quantum physics, you've lost me there.
examples_extra: Sorry, you’ve lost me there.
You’ve lost me there; explain again.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ یعنی «نفهمیدم چی گفتی».

meaning_en: the most sensible or effective course of action.
example_en: Your best bet is to ask the manager directly.
examples_extra: Your best bet is the train.
A taxi is your best bet.

meaning_en: your husband, wife, boyfriend, or girlfriend.
example_en: I'm going to the party with my other half.
examples_extra: Is your other half coming?
She came with your other half.

meaning_en: a formal closing used in letters when recipient's name is unknown.
example_en: I ended the formal letter with "Yours faithfully."
examples_extra: The letter ended: Yours faithfully.
She signed it Yours faithfully.
note_fa: پایان نامه رسمی (وقتی نام گیرنده معلوم نیست).

meaning_en: a contract offering no guaranteed working hours.
example_en: Many part-time workers are on zero hours contracts.
examples_extra: He works on a zero hours contract.
Zero hours contracts offer no security.

meaning_en: to move very quickly.
example_en: The car zipped past us on the highway.
examples_extra: She zipped past on her bike.
Cars zipped along the road.
note_fa: فعل: با سرعت رد شدن؛ zip up یعنی «زیپ را بستن».
